editor_note: No semantic drift and no hallucination: every table row matches its English description one-for-one (Circuit Cutting → "Kurangi lebar dan kedalaman Circuit dengan memotong gate dan wire", SLC → "untuk mengurangi overhead sampling PEC", MPF → "untuk simulasi Hamiltonian yang lebih baik"), and the closing two sentences ("Semua tutorial bisa dijalankan langsung di browser menggunakan Binder, atau di server Jupyter milikmu sendiri" / "kunjungi repo addon masing-masing") preserve both the Binder-or-own-server alternative and the "individual" repos qualifier. Informal register holds consistently ("milikmu", "bisa dijalankan" rather than deferential forms). The one thing a native technical editor would change is the opening sentence's "algoritma dan teknik komputasi kuantum yang terspesialisasi" for "specialized quantum computing algorithms and techniques": "terspesialisasi" is a rarely-used derived form that reads as a calque of the English participle; idiomatic Indonesian technical prose uses the plain adjective "khusus". Meaning is unaffected, so this is a naturalness slip only.

examples.source: official extension packages that provide specialized quantum computing algorithms and techniques
examples.translation: paket ekstensi resmi yang menyediakan algoritma dan teknik komputasi kuantum yang terspesialisasi
examples.suggested: paket ekstensi resmi yang menyediakan algoritma dan teknik komputasi kuantum khusus
examples.why: "terspesialisasi" is a non-standard ter- derivation that mirrors the English participle rather than Indonesian usage; "khusus" is the term a native technical writer would use here. Meaning is unchanged, so this is stylistic only.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: quantities (30-site chain, top 30 terms, noise scale 0.0, the single all-`Z` basis), the conditional "Semakin jauh $h$ dari sudut Clifford ..., semakin sulit mempropagasi generator anti-noise", and both non-monotonicity caveats on `max_err_terms`/`max_obs_terms` match the English exactly, and the informal "kita"/"kamu" register holds throughout. What a native technical editor would change is consistency and phrasing: the file splits its core nouns mid-document — "Circuit" (lines 18-79, 137-220) versus "sirkuit" (lines 313-470), and "box" (lines 137-145) versus "kotak" (lines 313-315, 332) — so the same object is named two ways in one page. Two coinages read as MT rather than as native technical Indonesian: "sirkuit bernoisy" (line 332, an English adjective given an Indonesian ber- prefix; "sirkuit ber-noise"/"sirkuit yang ber-noise" or simply "sirkuit bising" would be written by a native author) and "Gate satu qubit akan didress di kiri dalam box" (line 139), a direct calque of "left-dressed". Two mild strength shifts: "substantial noise" → "noise yang cukup besar" (line 28, "cukup besar" reads as "fairly large", softer than "substantial") and "executing the experiment is straightforward" → "mengeksekusi eksperimen menjadi sangat mudah" (line 470, "very easy" is stronger than "straightforward"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: circuit / box
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering per term and use it throughout — e.g. "sirkuit" everywhere and "box" everywhere.
examples.why: The same object is named two different ways in one page; the split falls neatly at the section boundary, so a reader may wonder whether "kotak sirkuit" is a different construct from the "box" of the earlier section.

examples.source: you will always need to provided a noisy circuit and observable. If your noisy circuit is a boxed circuit with `InjectNoise` annotations
examples.translation: kamu selalu perlu menyediakan sirkuit bernoisy dan observable. Jika sirkuit bernoisy-mu adalah sirkuit yang diberi kotak dengan anotasi `InjectNoise`
examples.suggested: kamu selalu perlu menyediakan sirkuit ber-noise dan observable. Jika sirkuit ber-noise milikmu adalah sirkuit yang sudah di-box dengan anotasi `InjectNoise`
examples.why: "bernoisy" welds an Indonesian prefix onto an English adjective — no Indonesian technical writer would form this word; "ber-noise" or "bising" is the natural choice.

examples.source: Single qubit gates will be left-dressed within the boxes.
examples.translation: Gate satu qubit akan didress di kiri dalam box.
examples.suggested: Gate satu qubit akan di-dress ke kiri (left-dressed) di dalam box.
examples.why: "didress di kiri" is a word-for-word calque of "left-dressed" with no hyphen on the English stem; it reads as raw MT and the reader cannot connect it back to the English term of art.

examples.source: will be affected by substantial noise / executing the experiment is straightforward
examples.translation: akan dipengaruhi oleh noise yang cukup besar / mengeksekusi eksperimen menjadi sangat mudah
examples.suggested: akan dipengaruhi oleh noise yang substansial / mengeksekusi eksperimen menjadi mudah (or: cukup sederhana)
examples.why: "cukup besar" softens "substantial" to "fairly large", while "sangat mudah" strengthens "straightforward" to "very easy" — small emphasis shifts in opposite directions in teaching prose.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantitative and conditional claim survives intact (the "batas trivial sebesar dua" bullet, the "Hanya pada qubit 6 ... error Z gagal untuk komut, sementara error X justru komut" contrast, the EN note's forward/backward switch wording, and the "~10k" convergence bullets all match). Informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native technical editor would change: (1) "triangle inequality" is rendered "ketidaksetaraan segitiga" — that noun means social inequality; the math term is "ketaksamaan/pertidaksamaan segitiga"; (2) "kicked Ising Hamiltonian" is literalized to "Hamiltonian Ising yang ditendang", and "qubit index subtleties" to "kehalusan indeks qubit", both calques; (3) terminology splits within the file: layer → "layer" (early) vs "lapisan" (from Step 2 on), noise rates → "laju noise" (Background) vs "tingkat noise" (Step 3), workflow → "alur kerja" vs "workflow", and kuantum vs quantum ("Circuit kuantum sembarang" vs "circuit quantum kita" / "perangkat quantum nyata"). None of these makes a concept unidentifiable.

examples.source: we revert to a looser bound that uses the triangle inequality
examples.translation: kita kembali ke batas yang lebih longgar menggunakan ketidaksetaraan segitiga
examples.suggested: kita kembali ke batas yang lebih longgar menggunakan ketaksamaan segitiga
examples.why: "Ketidaksetaraan" is inequality in the social/equity sense; the established Indonesian mathematical term for the triangle inequality is "ketaksamaan segitiga" (or "pertidaksamaan segitiga"). Recognizable, so MINOR, but wrong register for a math term.

examples.source: These patterns are characteristic of this kicked Ising Hamiltonian time-evolution problem
examples.translation: Pola-pola ini merupakan karakteristik dari masalah evolusi waktu Hamiltonian Ising yang ditendang ini
examples.suggested: Pola-pola ini merupakan karakteristik dari masalah evolusi waktu Hamiltonian kicked Ising ini
examples.why: "Ditendang" is the literal physical sense of kicking; "kicked Ising" is a fixed model name the Indonesian literature keeps in English. The calque reads comically to a native quantum engineer.

examples.source: layer / layers (throughout)
examples.translation: "layer unik", "layer 2Q", "layer Gate dua-qubit" early; "setiap lapisan boxed", "lapisan paling kanan", "lapisan 2-qubit unik" from Step 2 on
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering (e.g. "layer") and use it for every occurrence, including "layer boxed".
examples.why: The same concept alternates between the English loan and the Indonesian word within one tutorial, and the hybrid "lapisan boxed" mixes both in one phrase. Not misleading, but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: noise rates
examples.translation: "laju noise yang dipelajari" (Background, section b QPU) vs "tingkat noise yang terkait" / "tingkat noise yang dipelajari" (Step 3, b.i)
examples.suggested: Use "laju noise" consistently; "tingkat" reads as level rather than rate.
examples.why: Split rendering of a core quantity; "tingkat" slightly blurs rate vs level, though context keeps it identifiable.

examples.source: which is convenient for showcasing PEC implementations
examples.translation: yang praktis untuk memamerkan implementasi PEC
examples.suggested: yang praktis untuk mendemonstrasikan implementasi PEC
examples.why: "Memamerkan" carries a show-off connotation; technical writing would use "mendemonstrasikan" or "menampilkan".

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every claim tracks the English, including the delicate ones (the "~16 mH" vs "1 kcal/mol ≈ 1.6 mH" chemical-accuracy aside, "sampel kuantum dalam demo ini adalah noise murni", and "elektron spin-up dan spin-down sama-sama menempati lima orbital pertama"), and the informal "kamu"/"kita" convention holds. What a native editor would change is translationese in three spots: the mathematical "supported in a set of basis states" is calqued as "fungsi gelombang didukung dalam satu set state basis" (reads as "endorsed/backed" rather than "bertumpu pada"); "each line take a zig-zag shape" becomes "setiap garis mengambil bentuk zig-zag" instead of the natural "berbentuk zig-zag"; and "parameterized quantum circuit" is rendered "Circuit kuantum terparameter" where the field writes "terparameterisasi". There is also a within-file split on the core term: "sirkuit kuantum" / "satu sirkuit" appears at the SQD-framework paragraph and in Step 3, while the rest of the file consistently keeps "Circuit". None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: the wave function is supported in a set of basis states $\mathcal{S} = \{|x\rangle \}$ whose size does not increase exponentially
examples.translation: fungsi gelombang didukung dalam satu set state basis $\mathcal{S} = \{|x\rangle \}$ yang ukurannya tidak bertambah secara eksponensial
examples.suggested: fungsi gelombang bertumpu pada himpunan state basis $\mathcal{S} = \{|x\rangle \}$ yang ukurannya tidak bertambah secara eksponensial
examples.why: "didukung" is a literal calque of the mathematical sense of "supported"; in Indonesian it reads as "backed/endorsed". "bertumpu pada" (or "memiliki tumpuan pada") is the rendering an Indonesian physicist would use.

examples.source: where each line take a zig-zag shape due the heavy-hex connectivity of the target hardware
examples.translation: di mana setiap garis mengambil bentuk zig-zag karena konektivitas heavy-hex dari hardware target
examples.suggested: di mana setiap garis berbentuk zig-zag karena konektivitas heavy-hex hardware target
examples.why: "mengambil bentuk" is a word-for-word calque of "takes the shape"; native technical Indonesian uses "berbentuk". The chained "dari hardware target" is likewise an English-genitive calque.

examples.source: The ``LUCJ`` ansatz is a parameterized quantum circuit
examples.translation: Ansatz ``LUCJ`` adalah Circuit kuantum terparameter
examples.suggested: Ansatz ``LUCJ`` adalah Circuit kuantum terparameterisasi
examples.why: "terparameter" is not the established form; the domain term is "terparameterisasi" (or "berparameter"). Recognizable, so MINOR, but it is not the conventional rendering.

examples.source: a quantum circuit prepares the state $|\Psi\rangle$ … As we only have one circuit
examples.translation: sebuah sirkuit kuantum mempersiapkan state $|\Psi\rangle$ … Karena kita hanya memiliki satu sirkuit
examples.suggested: sebuah Circuit kuantum mempersiapkan state $|\Psi\rangle$ … Karena kita hanya memiliki satu Circuit
examples.why: The file otherwise keeps "Circuit" throughout (lines 14, 68, 70, 173, 183, 220); these two paragraphs switch to "sirkuit". The concept stays identifiable, so this is a within-file consistency slip, not a FAIL.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantitative and conditional claim survives intact (the `(8 choose 4)**2 = 4900` passage, "dengan probabilitas tinggi setiap orbital mengandung satu elektron", "Pada iterasi terakhir, kita melakukan diagonalisasi di seluruh ruang Hilbert", and the convergence caveat "Dengan asumsi keadaan awal yang baik dan sparsitas dari ground state"). Three renderings a native technical editor would change: "Self-consistent configuration recovery loop" becomes "Loop pemulihan konfigurasi mandiri", where "mandiri" reads as "independent/standalone" and loses the self-consistency (swakonsisten) that names the algorithm's fixed-point loop; "one- and two-body Hamiltonians" is calqued as "Hamiltonian satu-badan dan dua-badan" ("badan" = body in the corporeal/organizational sense — Indonesian physics uses "satu-benda/dua-benda" or keeps one-body/two-body), used consistently in all three occurrences; and the opening sentence drops the "post-" of "post-process noisy quantum samples" ("memproses sampel kuantum yang bising"), even though the same term is correctly rendered "Pasca-proses" in the step list below. Also one calqued noun-phrase order: "sekumpulan ``16``-Qubit keadaan basis Krylov" instead of "sekumpulan keadaan basis Krylov 16-Qubit". Register is consistently the informal "kita"-based instructional voice; no deferential slips.

examples.source: Self-consistent configuration recovery loop
examples.translation: Loop pemulihan konfigurasi mandiri
examples.suggested: Loop pemulihan konfigurasi swakonsisten (self-consistent)
examples.why: "mandiri" means independent/self-sufficient, not self-consistent; the loop's defining property — iterating until occupancies and recovered bitstrings agree — disappears from the name a learner is meant to carry into Step 4.

examples.source: we will create the one- and two-body Hamiltonians describing the one-dimensional single-impurity Anderson model
examples.translation: kita akan membuat Hamiltonian satu-badan dan dua-badan yang menggambarkan model Anderson impuritas tunggal (SIAM) satu dimensi
examples.suggested: Hamiltonian satu-benda dan dua-benda (atau: suku one-body dan two-body)
examples.why: "badan" is body in the corporeal/institutional sense; Indonesian physics writing uses "benda" (or keeps one-body/two-body). Recognizable but reads as a literal calque; occurs three times (lines 44, 77, 119).

examples.source: showing how to post-process noisy quantum samples to find an approximation to the ground state
examples.translation: yang menunjukkan cara memproses sampel kuantum yang bising untuk menemukan pendekatan ground state
examples.suggested: cara melakukan pasca-proses (post-process) sampel kuantum yang bising
examples.why: The "post-" qualifier is dropped in the lead sentence, flattening the article's central point that the work happens after sampling; the same term is rendered correctly as "Pasca-proses" in the Step 4 bullet, so the file is also inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: process samples taken from a set of ``16``-qubit Krylov basis states over increasing time intervals
examples.translation: memproses sampel yang diambil dari sekumpulan ``16``-Qubit keadaan basis Krylov pada interval waktu yang semakin meningkat
examples.suggested: memproses sampel yang diambil dari sekumpulan keadaan basis Krylov 16-Qubit
examples.why: English pre-modifier order kept verbatim; Indonesian puts the modifier after the head noun, so the current phrasing momentarily reads as "a set of 16 Qubits, Krylov basis states".

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: the CVaR endpoints ($\alpha=1$ → nilai ekspektasi standar, $\alpha=0$ → minimum), the "ekor bawah $\alpha$" definition, the 500-qubit scaling claim, and the cut/no-cut negation pair (eigenvalue $-1$ → "termasuk dalam potongan", $+1$ → "tidak termasuk") are all faithful, and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native editor would change is terminology hygiene. In the Requirements list rustworkx is called "Pustaka grafik Rustworkx", using "grafik" (chart/graphics) where the rest of the file correctly and consistently uses graph-theory "graf" (lines 99–101, 239–243) — the one place a reader could misread what the library is for. "Error mitigation" is rendered two ways in the same file ("teknik mitigasi kesalahan" in Background vs "teknik mitigasi error" in Step 3), and "quantum" is left English in one link title ("optimasi quantum skala utilitas") while "optimasi kuantum" is used elsewhere; "sirkuit" appears once (line 241) alongside the file's usual "Circuit". Two calques remain: "sambil tetap menerapkan beberapa penghitungan rata-rata" for "while still applying some averaging" (reads as "several average computations"), and "Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik" for "If you found this work interesting". None of these mislead.

examples.source: Rustworkx graph library (`pip install rustworkx`)
examples.translation: Pustaka grafik Rustworkx (`pip install rustworkx`)
examples.suggested: Pustaka graf Rustworkx (`pip install rustworkx`)
examples.why: "grafik" in Indonesian means chart/graphics, not a graph-theory graph; the rest of the file correctly uses "graf" (graf dengan 100 node, memetakan ulang graf), so this one bullet both breaks file consistency and mislabels what rustworkx does.

examples.source: the CVaR can be used as an error mitigation technique … / The CVaR can be used as an error mitigation technique as previously discussed
examples.translation: CVaR dapat digunakan sebagai teknik mitigasi kesalahan … / CVaR dapat digunakan sebagai teknik mitigasi error …
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering for "error mitigation" ("mitigasi error" is the more common Indonesian quantum-computing usage) and use it in both places.
examples.why: The same concept, referenced back explicitly ("seperti yang telah dibahas sebelumnya"), is named two different ways, weakening the cross-reference for the learner.

examples.source: while still applying some averaging to smooth out the optimization landscape
examples.translation: sambil tetap menerapkan beberapa penghitungan rata-rata untuk memuluskan lanskap optimasi
examples.suggested: sambil tetap melakukan sedikit perataan untuk memuluskan lanskap optimasi
examples.why: "beberapa penghitungan rata-rata" calques mass-noun "some averaging" as countable "several averaging computations"; a native technical writer would use "sedikit perataan".

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.suggested: Jika kamu merasa karya ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.why: "menemukan … menarik" is a literal calque of English "found X interesting"; Indonesian uses "merasa/menganggap … menarik".

examples.source: The [Solve utility-scale quantum optimization problems] tutorial
examples.translation: Tutorial [Selesaikan masalah optimasi quantum skala utilitas]
examples.suggested: Tutorial [Selesaikan masalah optimasi kuantum skala utilitas]
examples.why: "quantum" is left in English here while the file elsewhere uses the naturalized "kuantum" (optimasi kuantum, masalah kuantum, hardware kuantum).

editor_note: No semantic drift: every number, comparison and caveat survives intact (24%/36% benchmark reduction, "~16% two-qubit depth lebih rendah … biaya ~9% jumlah Gate yang lebih tinggi", the positive-vs-negative reading of the % column, the coupling-map limitation at the end). What a native technical editor would change is wording. "Introduce noise" is calqued throughout as "memperkenalkan noise" / "noise yang diperkenalkan" (lines ~408, ~412) — "memperkenalkan" is the social sense of introduce; Indonesian technical prose uses "menimbulkan"/"menambahkan noise". "Survival probability" is rendered "probabilitas bertahan hidup" (lines ~408, ~412, ~626), a biological over-translation where "probabilitas bertahan" / "probabilitas kelangsungan" is the domain wording. "Depth" is rendered inconsistently: "kedalaman 4/8" and "pengurangan kedalaman" in some paragraphs, bare "depth" and "two-qubit depth" in others, plus "depth dua-qubit" in the learning outcomes — three surface forms for one metric. Two smaller slips: "takes noticeably longer" loses "noticeably" ("memerlukan waktu yang lebih lama", line ~334), and "Optimasi depth adalah salah satu tujuan utama yang dilatih model routing AI" (line ~620) is syntactically stranded — it reads as "objectives the model trains" rather than "objectives the model is trained on". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: quantifies how much noise each transpilation strategy introduces
examples.translation: mengkuantifikasi berapa banyak noise yang diperkenalkan oleh setiap strategi transpilasi
examples.suggested: mengukur seberapa banyak noise yang ditimbulkan oleh setiap strategi transpilasi
examples.why: "memperkenalkan" is the social sense of "introduce" (introducing a person); for noise/error Indonesian technical writing uses "menimbulkan"/"menambahkan". Recurs at line ~412 ("transpilasi memperkenalkan lebih sedikit noise").

examples.source: The survival probability, defined as the fraction of shots that return the all-zeros bitstring
examples.translation: Probabilitas bertahan hidup, yang didefinisikan sebagai fraksi shot yang mengembalikan bitstring all-zeros
examples.suggested: Probabilitas bertahan (survival probability), yang didefinisikan sebagai fraksi shot yang mengembalikan bitstring all-zeros
examples.why: "bertahan hidup" is the biological/literal survival sense; a quantum engineer would write "probabilitas bertahan" or keep "survival probability". Used three times (~408, ~412, ~626).

examples.source: two-qubit depth / depth 4 / depth reduction
examples.translation: "depth dua-qubit" (l.25), "kedalaman 4" (l.225), "pengurangan kedalaman" (l.320), "two-qubit depth" (l.330, 334, 620)
examples.suggested: pick one convention — e.g. keep "depth" / "two-qubit depth" everywhere, or "kedalaman" / "kedalaman dua-qubit" everywhere
examples.why: The same metric appears under three surface forms in one file; the concept stays identifiable, but the inconsistency is visible to a reader scanning the analysis sections.

examples.source: Depth optimization is one of the primary objectives the AI routing model is trained on
examples.translation: Optimasi depth adalah salah satu tujuan utama yang dilatih model routing AI
examples.suggested: Optimasi depth adalah salah satu tujuan utama yang menjadi dasar pelatihan model routing AI
examples.why: As written the relative clause reads "objectives that the AI routing model trains", leaving the sentence syntactically stranded; the parallel sentence at line ~330 handles the same idea better ("yang dilatih model routing AI untuk dioptimalkan").

examples.source: The AI-powered transpiler takes noticeably longer and scales with circuit size
examples.translation: Transpiler bertenaga AI memerlukan waktu yang lebih lama dan skalanya bertumbuh seiring ukuran Circuit
examples.suggested: Transpiler bertenaga AI memerlukan waktu yang jauh lebih lama dan skalanya bertumbuh seiring ukuran Circuit
examples.why: The qualifier "noticeably" is dropped, softening the contrast the paragraph is making against SABRE's near-constant runtime. Not misleading — the numbers in the output block make the gap obvious — but the emphasis flattens.

editor_note: Delta entry 37 ("The Hamiltonian is as follows:" → "Hamiltoniannya adalah sebagai berikut:") is faithful and idiomatic — the -nya definite suffix plus "adalah sebagai berikut" is the natural Indonesian lead-in to the displayed XXZ formula, and "Hamiltonian" matches the term used throughout the file (e.g. "simulasi Hamiltonian $H$", "Mendefinisikan Hamiltonian, observabel, dan state awal").

No semantic drift or hallucination: every paragraph tracks the English, including the delicate DD bullet at the end ("mungkin justru memperburuk performa ... karena error pada pulsa dynamical decoupling itu sendiri") and the ZNE caveat ("peningkatan ini tidak gratis, karena hasil ZNE juga memiliki error bar yang lebih besar"). Four editorial slips remain. (1) ZNE is named two ways in the same file: the Background bullet list calls it "Ekstrapolasi noise-nol (ZNE)" while every other occurrence keeps "zero-noise extrapolation" — pick one, preferably the English form used elsewhere. (2) "Kami akan melewati langkah ini" uses exclusive kami for the English inclusive "We", clashing with the inclusive "Sebagai observable kita" and "untuk kita amati" used later. (3) "Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik" is a word-for-word calque of "If you found this work interesting"; a native writer would say "Jika materi ini menarik bagimu/Jika kamu tertarik dengan materi ini". (4) "useful for benchmarking the performance" is flattened to "berguna untuk menguji performa", dropping the benchmarking sense (tolok ukur / pembandingan performa). The informal "kamu" register holds throughout; no deferential bapak/ibu forms.

examples.source: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) / zero-noise extrapolation
examples.translation: Ekstrapolasi noise-nol (ZNE) in the Background bullet, but "zero-noise extrapolation" everywhere else
examples.suggested: Use "Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE)" in the bullet list too, matching the rest of the file
examples.why: The concept is still identifiable, but the same term is rendered two ways inside one short tutorial; a learner scanning the bullet list and then the result discussion sees two labels for one technique.

examples.source: We will forgo this step since runtime error mitigation is not supported on simulators.
examples.translation: Kami akan melewati langkah ini karena mitigasi error runtime tidak didukung pada simulator.
examples.suggested: Kita akan melewati langkah ini karena mitigasi error runtime tidak didukung pada simulator.
examples.why: Exclusive "kami" excludes the reader, while the rest of the file uses inclusive "kita" ("Sebagai observable kita", "untuk kita amati efek ini") for the same authorial we.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material...
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut...
examples.suggested: Jika materi ini menarik bagimu, kamu mungkin juga tertarik dengan bahan berikut...
examples.why: "menemukan karya ini menarik" is a literal calque of English find X interesting; Indonesian technical writers do not use menemukan that way, and "karya" for a tutorial reads oddly.

examples.source: the "mirror circuit" technique (also known as "compute-uncompute"), which is useful for benchmarking the performance of quantum devices
examples.translation: teknik "mirror Circuit" (juga dikenal sebagai "compute-uncompute"), yang berguna untuk menguji performa perangkat kuantum
examples.suggested: ... yang berguna untuk mengukur tolok ukur (benchmarking) performa perangkat kuantum
examples.why: "menguji" reduces benchmarking to plain testing, losing the point that the mirror circuit supplies a known reference value against which device performance is measured — the very reason the technique was introduced two sentences earlier.

editor_note: No semantic drift found: every quantity, condition and caveat survives (the mirror-circuit caveats "menggandakan jumlah gate", "dapat meremehkan error tertentu ketika noise saling membatalkan secara simetris", the tie/>100% explanation, the <20 / >=20 Qubit split, and the "Ini tidak representatif dari hasil yang lebih luas" hedge are all intact), and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native technical editor would change is polish: two English words are left raw inside Indonesian sentences — "yang menjadikan worthwhile untuk mencoba semua alat" (line 1392) and "dibaca sebagai verdict tentang kualitas metode" (line 1402) — both ungrammatical in Indonesian. "scales" is rendered as "berkembang" ("menguji bagaimana setiap metode berkembang dalam hal kualitas sirkuit", line 1079), which reads as "develops" rather than "menskala/berperforma saat diskalakan". Two further calques: "Rata-rata metriknya sangat condong oleh beberapa outlier" (line 1390, "condong" cannot take a passive agent this way; "sangat terdistorsi/dipengaruhi oleh" is the Indonesian) and "mengikuti dengan dekat di sebagian besar sirkuit" (line 762) for "tracking closely". Also note the metric "Runtime" is consistently "Waktu eksekusi" (execution time) when it is in fact compilation wall-clock time — defensible because it is defined on line 65, but "waktu kompilasi" would be clearer.

examples.source: Each method outperforms the others in specific cases, which makes it worthwhile to try all available tools and select the best result for each circuit.
examples.translation: Setiap metode mengungguli yang lain dalam kasus tertentu, yang menjadikan worthwhile untuk mencoba semua alat yang tersedia dan memilih hasil terbaik untuk setiap sirkuit.
examples.suggested: ... sehingga layak untuk mencoba semua alat yang tersedia dan memilih hasil terbaik untuk setiap sirkuit.
examples.why: The English adjective "worthwhile" is left untranslated inside an Indonesian clause, producing ungrammatical prose ("menjadikan worthwhile untuk"). No Indonesian technical writer would leave a plain adjective in English here.

examples.source: ...so it should not be read as a verdict on overall method quality.
examples.translation: ...sehingga tidak boleh dibaca sebagai verdict tentang kualitas metode secara keseluruhan.
examples.suggested: ...sehingga tidak boleh dianggap sebagai vonis/kesimpulan akhir tentang kualitas metode secara keseluruhan.
examples.why: Second raw English word left in running prose; "vonis" or "kesimpulan akhir" is the natural Indonesian. Meaning survives, but it reads as untouched machine output.

examples.source: ...and test how each method scales in terms of circuit quality and compilation time.
examples.translation: ...dan menguji bagaimana setiap metode berkembang dalam hal kualitas sirkuit dan waktu kompilasi.
examples.suggested: ...dan menguji bagaimana setiap metode menskala (scaling-nya) dalam hal kualitas sirkuit dan waktu kompilasi.
examples.why: "berkembang" means "develops/grows", losing the scaling sense (behaviour as circuit size increases) that is the whole point of the large-scale section. Recognizable from context, so minor, but imprecise.

examples.source: Its average metrics are heavily skewed by a handful of significant outliers...
examples.translation: Rata-rata metriknya sangat condong oleh beberapa outlier signifikan...
examples.suggested: Rata-rata metriknya sangat terdistorsi oleh beberapa outlier signifikan...
examples.why: "condong oleh" is a direct calque of "skewed by"; in Indonesian "condong" takes "ke/kepada", not a passive agent, so the clause is ungrammatical.

examples.source: **Runtime**: The wall-clock time for transpilation.
examples.translation: **Waktu eksekusi**: Waktu clock untuk transpilasi.
examples.suggested: **Waktu kompilasi**: Waktu jam-dinding (wall-clock) untuk transpilasi.
examples.why: The metric measures compilation time, but "waktu eksekusi" reads as circuit execution time; the definition disambiguates it, so this is imprecision rather than a misleading claim. "Waktu clock" is also a half-translated calque of "wall-clock time".

editor_note: No semantic drift: every load-bearing claim survives intact — the teleportation corrections (X on qubit 3 for m12, Z on qubit 0 for m21), "MSE = 0 untuk Bell pair sempurna ... mendekati 1" for random outcomes, "lebih sulit dikoreksi dibanding kesalahan pada pengukuran akhir", and the CDF reading ("proporsi pasangan qubit yang memiliki MSE paling banyak sebesar itu"). What a native technical editor would change: "coupling map" is rendered "peta pasangan perangkat" (line ~428), a literal "pairing map" that collides awkwardly with "pasangan Bell" used throughout — the field keeps "coupling map" or uses "peta konektivitas"; "Familiarity dengan Circuit dinamis" (line ~34) leaves the English noun untranslated where "Pemahaman tentang" is expected; "top performers" becomes "pemain terbaik" (line ~567), a sports calque for what should be "berkinerja terbaik". Also, the "_uncut_ Bell pair" gloss loses "created directly ... without teleportation" (only "menggunakan Hadamard dan CNOT" remains) and misplaces the adverb, and "fidelity" is rendered "fidelitas" everywhere except the results paragraph, where it silently becomes "kualitas Bell state ... satu orde besarnya". None of these teach a false concept; informal register ("kamu") holds consistently.

examples.source: We programmatically search the device coupling map for all linearly-connected chains of four qubits.
examples.translation: Kita mencari secara terprogram pada peta pasangan perangkat untuk semua rantai empat qubit yang terhubung secara linier.
examples.suggested: Kita mencari secara terprogram pada coupling map perangkat untuk semua rantai empat qubit yang terhubung secara linier.
examples.why: "peta pasangan" is a literal rendering of "coupling map" that reads as "map of pairs" — especially confusing in a file where "pasangan" means Bell pair on nearly every other line. The domain keeps "coupling map" (or "peta konektivitas"). Recognizable from context, so MINOR.

examples.source: Familiarity with dynamic circuits (mid-circuit measurements and classical feedforward);
examples.translation: Familiarity dengan [Circuit dinamis] ([pengukuran mid-circuit] dan classical feedforward);
examples.suggested: Pemahaman tentang Circuit dinamis (pengukuran mid-circuit dan classical feedforward);
examples.why: "Familiarity" is an ordinary English noun left untranslated in the prerequisites list — not a kept domain term. A native writer would use "Pemahaman tentang" or "Terbiasa dengan".

examples.source: This makes it easy to spot which physical qubit pairs are the top performers (the far-left points on the CDF).
examples.translation: Ini memudahkan untuk menemukan pasangan qubit fisik mana yang menjadi pemain terbaik (titik paling kiri pada CDF).
examples.suggested: Ini memudahkan untuk menemukan pasangan qubit fisik mana yang berkinerja terbaik (titik paling kiri pada CDF).
examples.why: "pemain terbaik" literally means "best player" — a sports calque of "top performers" that no Indonesian technical writer would use for qubit pairs. Meaning is still inferable, so MINOR.

examples.source: qubits 1 and 2 are prepared locally in an _uncut_ Bell pair (a Bell pair created directly with a Hadamard and CNOT, without teleportation)
examples.translation: qubit 1 dan 2 disiapkan ke dalam pasangan Bell yang tidak dipotong secara lokal (menggunakan Hadamard dan CNOT)
examples.suggested: qubit 1 dan 2 disiapkan secara lokal dalam pasangan Bell yang _tidak dipotong_ (pasangan Bell yang dibuat langsung dengan Hadamard dan CNOT, tanpa teleportasi)
examples.why: The parenthetical gloss that defines "uncut" loses "created directly" and "without teleportation" — the exact contrast with the teleported pair the tutorial is about. Separately, "secara lokal" has drifted to modify "tidak dipotong" instead of "disiapkan". Explanatory nuance flattened, but the concept is still introduced.

examples.source: This confirms the paper's finding that there can be over an order of magnitude variation in Bell-state fidelity depending on which physical qubits are used.
examples.translation: Hal ini mengonfirmasi temuan makalah bahwa variasi kualitas Bell state bisa lebih dari satu orde besarnya tergantung pada qubit fisik mana yang digunakan.
examples.suggested: Hal ini mengonfirmasi temuan makalah bahwa variasi fidelitas Bell state bisa lebih dari satu orde besaran tergantung pada qubit fisik mana yang digunakan.
examples.why: "fidelity" is rendered "fidelitas" consistently elsewhere (lines 25, 43, 47, 566-end) but becomes the vaguer "kualitas" here; "satu orde besarnya" should be "satu orde besaran" (order of magnitude). Within-file inconsistency plus a slightly off set phrase — MINOR.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every constraint, number and caveat survives intact (RZZ range 0 < θ < π/2 and the ≤ variant in the workflow section, the v0.47.0 known-issue admonition, "waktu penggunaan QPU hampir identik", "sedikit pengurangan jumlah gate total"), and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) "workflow" is rendered inconsistently within the file — "alur kerja" in Background/Prerequisites/large-scale sections but bare English "workflow" from the kernel-circuit section onward (lines 206, 274, 320, 361, 421, 645-648); (2) the transpiler stage `translation` is rendered "terjemahan `constructor-beta`" (line 744), a linguistic-translation calque where the field means basis translation and the code cell below says `translation_method`; (3) "native interactions between physical qubits" becomes "interaksi alami" (line 47), weakening native/asli to "natural"; (4) "we benchmark the quantum kernel workflow" is flattened to "kita membandingkan" (line 490). None of these would mislead a learner about the physics or the API.

examples.source: The workflow for using fractional gates generally follows the Qiskit patterns workflow. / we explore the quantum kernel circuit using RZZ gates to introduce the workflow for fractional gates.
examples.translation: Alur kerja untuk menggunakan fractional gates umumnya mengikuti alur kerja Qiskit patterns. / ... untuk memperkenalkan workflow fractional gates.
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering and keep it — either "alur kerja" throughout or "workflow" throughout.
examples.why: The same concept is split between "alur kerja" and "workflow" inside one file; the concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but it reads as two different translators.

examples.source: Next, we apply the transpiler using `constructor-beta` translation provided by the `qiskit-basis-constructor` package.
examples.translation: Selanjutnya, kita menerapkan Transpiler menggunakan terjemahan `constructor-beta` yang disediakan oleh paket `qiskit-basis-constructor`.
examples.suggested: ... menggunakan metode translation (translasi basis) `constructor-beta` yang disediakan oleh paket `qiskit-basis-constructor`.
examples.why: "terjemahan" is the everyday word for translating language; here `translation` is a named transpiler stage (`translation_method="constructor-beta"` in the very next code cell), so the literal rendering breaks the link to the API the reader is about to type.

examples.source: By leveraging the native interactions between physical qubits, you can implement certain unitaries more efficiently on hardware.
examples.translation: Dengan memanfaatkan interaksi alami antara qubit fisik, kamu dapat mengimplementasikan unitary tertentu secara lebih efisien pada perangkat keras.
examples.suggested: Dengan memanfaatkan interaksi native (asli) antar-qubit fisik, ...
examples.why: "native" here means the interaction the device physically implements, not merely a "natural" one; "alami" is a weaker reading, and "antara qubit fisik" reads more idiomatically as "antar-qubit fisik".

examples.source: What fractional gates are and how they reduce circuit depth and duration on IBM QPUs
examples.translation: Apa itu fractional gates dan bagaimana mereka mengurangi kedalaman dan durasi Circuit pada QPU IBM
examples.suggested: Apa itu fractional gates dan bagaimana gate ini mengurangi kedalaman dan durasi circuit pada QPU IBM
examples.why: "mereka" as an anaphor for inanimate objects is calqued English; an Indonesian technical writer would repeat the noun or use "-nya".

editor_note: No semantic drift: every load-bearing claim survives intact — "marked" = fase -1, the $2^{N}-1$ state, X-gates before/after controlled-Z as open-control, the optimal-iteration ratio, exponential growth in the number of *control* qubits, and $O(\sqrt{2^n})$ iteration growth are all faithful, including the closing fault-tolerance paragraph. Three editor-level slips: (1) the closing sentence calques "beyond very small problem sizes" as "untuk ukuran masalah yang lebih dari sangat kecil", which no Indonesian technical writer would produce ("di luar ukuran masalah yang sangat kecil"); (2) Step 1 inserts an unsourced clause, "oracle yang melakukan hal tersebut, menandai..." where the English is simply "an oracle that marks..." — contextually true but not in the source; (3) within-file inconsistency in the qubit compound and gate-name order — "kedalaman Gate dua-Qubit" (capital Q) sits beside lowercase "jumlah qubit"/"tiga qubit", and "Gate controlled-Z" alternates with "Gate Z multi-controlled". Core terminology is otherwise correct and consistent (amplifikasi amplitudo, percepatan kuadratik, state basis komputasi, transpilasi, primitif Sampler, superposisi merata, operator difusi), and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout.

examples.source: This makes Grover's algorithm impractical on current noisy quantum hardware beyond very small problem sizes.
examples.translation: Ini membuat algoritma Grover tidak praktis pada hardware kuantum noisy saat ini untuk ukuran masalah yang lebih dari sangat kecil.
examples.suggested: Ini membuat algoritma Grover tidak praktis pada hardware kuantum noisy saat ini, di luar ukuran masalah yang sangat kecil.
examples.why: "lebih dari sangat kecil" is a word-for-word calque of "beyond very small"; the meaning survives but the phrase is not idiomatic Indonesian and reads as MT in the tutorial's concluding sentence.

examples.source: In the following code, we define an oracle that marks one or more input basis states defined through their bitstring representation.
examples.translation: Pada kode berikut, kita mendefinisikan oracle yang melakukan hal tersebut, menandai satu atau lebih state basis input yang didefinisikan melalui representasi bit-string-nya.
examples.suggested: Pada kode berikut, kita mendefinisikan oracle yang menandai satu atau lebih state basis input yang didefinisikan melalui representasi bit-string-nya.
examples.why: The clause "yang melakukan hal tersebut" ("that does this") has no counterpart in the English. It is accurate in context (it points back to the open-control technique just described) so it does not mislead, but it is an addition an editor would strike.

examples.source: the rapid growth of the circuit's two-qubit gate depth as the number of qubits increases
examples.translation: pertumbuhan pesat kedalaman Gate dua-Qubit pada Circuit seiring bertambahnya jumlah qubit
examples.suggested: pertumbuhan pesat kedalaman Gate dua-qubit pada Circuit seiring bertambahnya jumlah qubit
examples.why: Within one sentence "dua-Qubit" (capitalized) and "jumlah qubit" (lowercase) coexist; the same split recurs at lines 205, 247, 251 and 320. The concept stays identifiable, so this is cosmetic inconsistency, not a comprehension risk.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every prose paragraph (Background, Serverless description, Steps 3 & 4 rationale, Next steps) tracks the English claim for claim, the informal "kamu/kodemu" register holds throughout, and domain terms are consistent (pelarut implisit, zat/senyawa terlarut, medium dielektrik, alur kerja, energi keadaan dasar). What a native technical editor would change is phrasing: "untuk meningkatkan waktu komputasi" (for "to improve computation time") reads in Indonesian as *increasing* the computation time — "mempersingkat waktu komputasi" is what is meant; "hasilnya umumnya akan lebih perkiraan" is an un-Indonesian calque of "more approximate" (natural: "lebih bersifat perkiraan/lebih kasar"); "pemrosesan klasik pasca-komputasi" renders "post-processing" as "post-computation" ("pasca-pemrosesan" is the term used correctly elsewhere in the same file, e.g. "pasca-proses" in the Steps 3 & 4 heading, so it is also an internal inconsistency); and "Buat direktori tepat di sebelah program notebook utama yang bernama `source_files`" attaches the relative clause to the notebook rather than to the directory being created. None of these teaches a false concept, but all four are worth fixing.

examples.source: The code also demonstrates parallelization across the remotely available CPU cores to improve computation time.
examples.translation: Kode ini juga menunjukkan paralelisasi di berbagai core CPU yang tersedia secara jarak jauh untuk meningkatkan waktu komputasi.
examples.suggested: ... untuk mempersingkat waktu komputasi.
examples.why: "meningkatkan waktu komputasi" reads as making the computation take LONGER; the English means the opposite (a speed-up). Context rescues the reader, so it is a calque rather than a misleading claim, but it is the weakest sentence in the file.

examples.source: ...although the end result will generally be more approximate than the counterpart: more computationally costly explicit solvent models...
examples.translation: ...meskipun hasil akhirnya umumnya akan lebih perkiraan dibandingkan model pelarut eksplisit yang lebih mahal secara komputasi...
examples.suggested: ...meskipun hasil akhirnya umumnya lebih bersifat perkiraan (lebih kasar) dibandingkan...
examples.why: "lebih perkiraan" is a word-for-word calque of "more approximate"; "perkiraan" is a noun and cannot take "lebih" this way in Indonesian technical prose.

examples.source: offloading the computationally expensive classical post-processing of the quantum sampling portion of the routine
examples.translation: dengan mengalihkan pemrosesan klasik pasca-komputasi yang mahal secara komputasi dari bagian sampling kuantum dari rutinitas tersebut
examples.suggested: dengan mengalihkan pasca-pemrosesan klasik yang mahal secara komputasi atas bagian sampling kuantum dari rutinitas tersebut
examples.why: "post-processing" becomes "pasca-komputasi" (post-computation) here, while the Steps 3 & 4 heading and body correctly use "pasca-proses" — the same concept rendered two ways inside one file.

examples.source: Create a directory exactly next to the main notebook program called `source_files`.
examples.translation: Buat direktori tepat di sebelah program notebook utama yang bernama `source_files`.
examples.suggested: Buat direktori bernama `source_files` tepat di sebelah program notebook utama.
examples.why: Indonesian attaches "yang bernama `source_files`" to the nearest noun (the notebook program), so the sentence can be misread as naming the notebook instead of the new directory.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every section blurb (verifiable sampling, observable estimation, fault-tolerant, workload optimization, Qiskit Functions, addons, error mitigation/detection) matches the English claim-for-claim, including the "not depth-efficient ... more likely to demonstrate quantum advantage when fault-tolerant quantum computers exist" sentence, and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native editor would change: "CHSH inequality" is rendered "Ketidaksetaraan CHSH" (lines 27, 89) — "ketidaksetaraan" is the social-equity word; the mathematical term is "ketaksamaan"/"pertidaksamaan" CHSH. "Kicked Ising" is calqued as "Ising yang ditendang" (lines 136, 157), i.e. kicked with a foot, where the field convention keeps "kicked Ising" or uses "terdorong/terpandu periodik". "tilted-field Ising" loses its qualifier as "Ising 2D miring" (line 154) — the tilt belongs to the field, not the 2D model. Smaller: "error suppression" becomes the agent noun "penekan kesalahan" instead of "penekanan kesalahan" (line 145), "error" is left untranslated in "Pembatalan error probabilistik" (line 223) while every neighbouring entry uses "kesalahan", and "Model a flowing non-viscous fluid" reads as "fluida non-viskos mengalir" (line 172) where Indonesian needs "fluida non-viskos yang mengalir".

examples.source: CHSH inequality
examples.translation: Ketidaksetaraan CHSH
examples.suggested: Ketaksamaan CHSH (or Pertidaksamaan CHSH)
examples.why: "Ketidaksetaraan" is the social/equity sense of inequality; a mathematical inequality is "ketaksamaan"/"pertidaksamaan". Recognizable because CHSH is named, but it is the wrong domain word and is used twice.

examples.source: Simulation of kicked Ising Hamiltonian with dynamic circuits / Simulate a kicked Ising model with the TEM function
examples.translation: Simulasi Hamiltonian Ising yang ditendang dengan Circuit dinamis / Simulasikan model Ising yang ditendang dengan fungsi TEM
examples.suggested: Simulasi Hamiltonian kicked Ising … / model kicked Ising …
examples.why: "Ditendang" is the foot-kick sense; the physics term (periodically pulsed/driven Ising) is kept in English or rendered as "terdorong periodik" in Indonesian physics writing. Literal calque, consistent but jarring.

examples.source: Simulate 2D tilted-field Ising with the QESEM function
examples.translation: Simulasi Ising 2D miring dengan fungsi QESEM
examples.suggested: Simulasi Ising medan-miring 2D dengan fungsi QESEM
examples.why: "Field" is dropped, so the tilt attaches to the 2D model/lattice instead of the field — a tilted-field Ising model means transverse plus longitudinal field, not a tilted lattice.

examples.source: error suppression … Probabilistic error cancellation
examples.translation: penekan kesalahan … Pembatalan error probabilistik
examples.suggested: penekanan kesalahan … Pembatalan kesalahan probabilistik
examples.why: "Penekan" is the agent noun (suppressor) inside a list of process nouns (transpilasi, mitigasi); and "error" is left in English in one entry while every sibling entry in the same accordion uses "kesalahan".

examples.source: Model a flowing non-viscous fluid using QUICK-PDE
examples.translation: Pemodelan fluida non-viskos mengalir menggunakan QUICK-PDE
examples.suggested: Pemodelan fluida non-viskos yang mengalir menggunakan QUICK-PDE
examples.why: Stacked post-modifiers without "yang" read as English word order; a native technical writer would insert the relativizer.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no inverted conditions, swapped quantities, dropped caveats or hallucinated claims; the delicate parts (the H = (H−T) + T shifting argument, τ determined only by the ZZ terms, "ini adalah keadaan dasar *dalam sektor eksitasi tunggal* ... bukan keadaan dasar global", the r-flexibility appendix) all track the English exactly, and the reps=8 numbers 0.045 vs 0.075 are right. What a native editor would still change: eight prose fragments are left completely untranslated, including two full teaching sentences — line 433 ("Such matrices where the elements depend on the index differences ... are called *Toeplitz* ...", the only place Toeplitz is explained) and line 991 ("where $d=2^n$ is the dimension of the Hilbert space"), plus line 73 and the connectives "Then," / "Here," / "and" / "where" / "Therefore," at lines 734, 756, 794, 1293, 1333. Several calques read as MT rather than as an Indonesian engineer writing: "kita menyapu jumlah repetisi Trotter" (sweep → literal "menyapu"), "mengempiskan kedalaman dari 15 menjadi 6" (collapse → "deflate"), "dapat memperkenalkan overhead routing" (introduce → "memperkenalkan" in the "acquaint" sense). "resolve the low-lying spectrum" became "menyelesaikan spektrum berenergi rendah", which reads as "solving" rather than spectrally resolving. Register mixes "kamu" (lines 40, 133) with "Anda" (line 2378) in the same file. None of these misleads, so MINOR, not FAIL.

examples.source: Such matrices where the elements depend on the index differences in this manner are called *Toeplitz* and can be reconstructed from first-row elements indexed by $d=\ell-k$.
examples.translation: Such matrices where the elements depend on the index differences in this manner are called *Toeplitz* and can be reconstructed from first-row elements indexed by $d=\ell-k$.
examples.suggested: Matriks yang elemennya bergantung pada selisih indeks seperti ini disebut *Toeplitz* dan dapat direkonstruksi dari elemen-elemen baris pertama yang diindeks oleh $d=\ell-k$.
examples.why: Left entirely in English — this is the only sentence that defines what Toeplitz means and why only the first row is measured. Lines 73 ('where the denominator normalizes the state.') and 991 ('where $d=2^n$ is the dimension of the Hilbert space') are untranslated too, plus the connectives at 734, 756, 794, 1293, 1333.

examples.source: we sweep the number of Trotter repetitions to separate the orderings more clearly
examples.translation: kita menyapu jumlah repetisi Trotter untuk memisahkan urutan-urutan tersebut secara lebih jelas
examples.suggested: kita memvariasikan jumlah repetisi Trotter untuk memisahkan urutan-urutan tersebut secara lebih jelas
examples.why: 'menyapu' is the broom sense of sweep; no Indonesian technical writer sweeps a parameter. Same class: 'mengempiskan kedalaman dari 15 menjadi 6' (line 1181, collapse→deflate) and 'dapat memperkenalkan overhead routing' (line 1275, introduce→'acquaint').

examples.source: a large enough Krylov space to resolve the low-lying spectrum
examples.translation: ruang Krylov yang cukup besar untuk menyelesaikan spektrum berenergi rendah
examples.suggested: ruang Krylov yang cukup besar untuk mengurai (memisahkan) spektrum berenergi rendah
examples.why: 'resolve' here is spectral resolution, not solving; 'menyelesaikan' reads as 'finish/solve the spectrum'. Recognizable from context, so minor, but the intuition of resolving nearby levels is lost.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material
examples.translation: Jika Anda merasa pekerjaan ini menarik, Anda mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut
examples.suggested: Jika kamu merasa pekerjaan ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut
examples.why: The file addresses the reader as 'kamu' at lines 40 and 133 but switches to 'Anda' in the closing section; pick one within a file.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout: the ZZ-parity→X-on-target / XX-parity→Z-on-control mapping, the odd-vs-even distance branch in "Menyiapkan Bell pair", the O(n) vs constant-depth crossover argument, and the 2.280 ns readout vs 68 ns 2Q-gate comparison all survive intact, and the informal "kamu"/"kita" register holds. The defects are editorial, not misleading. (1) The hedge "up to Pauli corrections" is flattened to "dengan koreksi Pauli" ("with Pauli corrections"), losing the "only modulo" sense — the follow-on clause about feedforward rescues it, so it is a weakened qualifier rather than a false claim. (2) Core terms split within the file: "fidelity" (most of the file) vs "fidelitas" (lines 299, 549), and "sirkuit" through the first half vs capitalized "Circuit"/"dua-Qubit"/"Gate" from line 484 onward. (3) Two hard calques: "Sekarang bahwa kita telah memiliki…" (line 594, ungrammatical rendering of "Now that we have"; line 446 gets the same construction right with "Sekarang setelah…") and "Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik" (line 1076), where "pekerjaan" reads as "job/chore" instead of "materi/topik". Also "LRCX jarak jauh" (lines 477, 488) is tautological since LRCX already expands to long-range CX.

examples.source: This creates a long-range Bell pair between the target qubit, and the qubit adjacent to the control (up to Pauli corrections, which will be implemented via feedforward in the next step).
examples.translation: Ini menciptakan Bell pair jarak jauh antara qubit target dan qubit yang berdekatan dengan kontrol (dengan koreksi Pauli, yang akan diimplementasikan melalui feedforward pada langkah berikutnya).
examples.suggested: … (hingga koreksi Pauli, yang akan diimplementasikan melalui feedforward pada langkah berikutnya).
examples.why: "up to X" is a modulo/except-for qualifier; "dengan koreksi Pauli" reads as "with Pauli corrections already applied", softening the caveat that the pair is only correct up to those byproducts.

examples.source: Now that we have both dynamic and unitary circuits for a range of distances, we are ready for transpilation.
examples.translation: Sekarang bahwa kita telah memiliki sirkuit dinamis dan unitary untuk berbagai jarak, kita siap untuk transpilasi.
examples.suggested: Sekarang setelah kita memiliki sirkuit dinamis dan unitary untuk berbagai jarak, kita siap melakukan transpilasi.
examples.why: "Sekarang bahwa" is a word-for-word calque of "Now that" and is not grammatical Indonesian; line 446 of the same file already uses the correct "Sekarang setelah…".

examples.source: fidelity
examples.translation: "fidelitas" at lines 299 and 549, but "fidelity" everywhere else
examples.suggested: Pick one — "fidelity" is the dominant form in this file — and use it throughout.
examples.why: The same core metric is rendered two ways within one tutorial; the concept stays identifiable, so this is a consistency slip, not a comprehension barrier.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following materials:
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi-materi berikut:
examples.suggested: Jika kamu tertarik dengan topik ini, materi berikut mungkin berguna:
examples.why: "menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik" calques "found this work interesting"; "pekerjaan" in Indonesian means a job/chore, not a piece of scientific work.

examples.source: Define quality metrics for evaluating the performance of the long-range CX. / To evaluate the success of the long-range CX protocol
examples.translation: Mendefinisikan metrik kualitas untuk mengevaluasi performa LRCX jarak jauh. / Untuk mengevaluasi keberhasilan protokol LRCX jarak jauh
examples.suggested: … performa CX jarak jauh … / … protokol LRCX …
examples.why: LRCX already stands for long-range CX, so "LRCX jarak jauh" is a tautology a native technical editor would trim.

examples.source: The main present-day motivation is reduced two-qubit depth, not necessarily improved fidelity.
examples.translation: Motivasi utama saat ini adalah berkurangnya *kedalaman dua-Qubit*, tidak harus peningkatan fidelity.
examples.suggested: … berkurangnya *kedalaman dua-qubit*, belum tentu peningkatan fidelity.
examples.why: "tidak harus" reads as "is not required to be"; "belum tentu" is the idiomatic rendering of "not necessarily".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no inverted condition, swapped quantity, softened claim, dropped caveat or hallucinated sentence; the three approximations, the differential meson-minus-vacuum protocol, the 3400/14.000 gate counts, the 8,5-jam PPM figure and the atol trade-off all track the English exactly, and the informal "kamu" register holds in the body. What a native technical editor would still change: (1) within-file term splits — "circuit" in the Learning-outcomes bullets vs "sirkuit" everywhere in the body; "kisi" in the frontmatter/bullets vs "lattice" in all body prose ("lattice spasial 1D", "situs lattice", "lattice 30-situs"); "primitive Qiskit Estimator" (outcomes) vs "primitif Qiskit Estimator" (prerequisites, Langkah 3); "mitigasi error readout" (outcomes) vs "mitigasi error pembacaan" (hardware bullet); and "Runtime Anda" in the usage-estimate line against "kamu" in the rest. (2) Two malformed/imprecise renderings: "Setelah rescaling ke bentuk dimensiless" uses a non-word (neither "dimensionless" nor "tak berdimensi"/"nirdimensi"), and "semua prefaktor ini menyederhanakan menjadi satuan" renders "simplify to unity" with "satuan" (a unit of measure) plus an intransitive-needed verb, where "tersederhanakan menjadi satu" is the physics reading. (3) "nomor loop" for "loop number" ($n_l$) reads as an index label rather than an occupation quantity — "bilangan loop"/"jumlah loop" is the conventional term, and the preceding "tiga bilangan kuantum" keeps it recoverable, so this is a slip, not a false concept.

examples.source: How to construct Trotterized time-evolution circuits … / How to run these circuits on IBM Quantum hardware
examples.translation: Bagaimana membangun circuit evolusi waktu yang di-Trotterisasi … / Bagaimana menjalankan circuit-circuit ini …
examples.suggested: Bagaimana membangun sirkuit evolusi waktu yang di-Trotterisasi … / Bagaimana menjalankan sirkuit-sirkuit ini …
examples.why: The Learning-outcomes bullets keep English "circuit" while the entire body ("Sirkuit kuantum tidak mensimulasikan…", "sirkuit kompak dengan 2N qubit", "Merakit sirkuit Trotterisasi penuh") uses "sirkuit". Same concept, two renderings in one file.

examples.source: After rescaling to dimensionless form, the Hamiltonian is:
examples.translation: Setelah rescaling ke bentuk dimensiless, Hamiltonian-nya adalah:
examples.suggested: Setelah penskalaan ulang ke bentuk tak berdimensi, Hamiltonian-nya adalah:
examples.why: "dimensiless" is not a word in either language — an artifact halfway between "dimensionless" and an Indonesian form. A reader hits a nonsense token at the point where the rescaling is being explained.

examples.source: three quantum numbers $(n_l, n_i, n_o)$ representing the loop number, incoming string, and outgoing string
examples.translation: tiga bilangan kuantum $(n_l, n_i, n_o)$ yang mewakili nomor loop, string masuk, dan string keluar
examples.suggested: tiga bilangan kuantum $(n_l, n_i, n_o)$ yang mewakili bilangan loop, string masuk, dan string keluar
examples.why: "nomor" in Indonesian means an identifying/ordinal number (house number, serial number), not a counted quantity. $n_l$ is an occupation-like quantum number, so "bilangan loop" (matching the "bilangan kuantum" and "bilangan fermion" used two sentences later) is the domain term.

examples.source: all these prefactors simplify to unity
examples.translation: semua prefaktor ini menyederhanakan menjadi satuan
examples.suggested: semua prefaktor ini tersederhanakan menjadi satu
examples.why: "satuan" reads as "a unit (of measurement)" rather than the number one, and "menyederhanakan" is transitive so the sentence has no object. The intended physics — the prefactors become 1 — survives only by inference.

examples.source: readout error mitigation / TREX readout error mitigation
examples.translation: mitigasi error readout (Hasil pembelajaran) … mitigasi error pembacaan TREX (bullet hardware)
examples.suggested: Pick one: "mitigasi error pembacaan (readout)" in both places.
examples.why: The same technique is named two ways in one tutorial; a learner scanning for the term used in the learning outcomes will not find it in the hardware section.

examples.source: Your runtime may vary.
examples.translation: Runtime Anda mungkin bervariasi.
examples.suggested: Runtime kamu mungkin bervariasi.
examples.why: The file otherwise addresses the reader as "kamu" throughout ("fase global yang bisa kamu abaikan", "sehingga kamu bisa memverifikasi", "Dari ⟨Z⟩ kamu bisa mengekstrak"). The single "Anda" in the opening line breaks the convention.

examples.source: Rust-accelerated classical simulation via Pauli back-propagation
examples.translation: simulasi klasik yang dipercepat Rust melalui Pauli back-propagation
examples.suggested: simulasi klasik yang dipercepat dengan Rust melalui propagasi-balik Pauli
examples.why: "dipercepat Rust" is a calque of the English compound adjective; Indonesian needs the preposition ("dipercepat dengan/oleh Rust"). Grammatical-adjacent but not how a native technical writer would phrase it.

editor_note: Judging only the delta entry 51: the Requirements bullet "Qiskit addon utilities (`pip install qiskit-addon-utils`)" renders as "Utilitas addon Qiskit (`pip install qiskit-addon-utils`)" — "Utilitas" is the conventional Indonesian for a utilities package, "addon" is correctly kept as the Qiskit product term (matching the neighbouring "MPF Qiskit addon dengan backend TeNPy" bullet), the pip command is untouched, and the noun order "Utilitas addon Qiskit" is natural Indonesian rather than a calqued word-for-word string. Nothing misleading and nothing a native technical editor would change.

The central concept of the tutorial is mistranslated along the wrong axis: "long-range" is rendered throughout as "jangka panjang", which in Indonesian is idiomatically and exclusively temporal ("long-term", as in "rencana jangka panjang"); the spatial sense requires "jarak jauh" (cf. "rudal jarak jauh"). So "the transition between short- and long-range ordered phases" becomes "peralihan antara fase teratur jangka pendek dan jangka panjang" — a learner is taught the Nishimori transition separates short-lived from long-lived ordered phases rather than phases distinguished by the spatial range of correlations, and the same error repeats in the learning outcomes, in "jerat jangka panjang", and in "ketertiban jangka panjang masih bisa dipulihkan hingga sudut kritis" where no nearby sentence corrects it. Compounding this, "long-range order" uses "ketertiban" (public order/discipline, a social word) instead of the physics term "keteraturan", and the noun "entanglement" is rendered as bare "jerat" (a snare/noose) rather than "keterjeratan" — though the verb forms "menjerat"/"terjerat" are used correctly. Two smaller slips: "what this sweep can resolve" becomes "yang bisa diselesaikan oleh sapuan ini" (false friend: resolve→finish/solve, not daya pisah), and "This value is maximized at the critical point" becomes "Nilai ini dimaksimalkan", implying an agent maximizes it rather than it attaining a maximum.

examples.source: The Nishimori phase transition refers to the transition between short- and long-range ordered phases in the random-bond Ising model.
examples.translation: Transisi fase Nishimori mengacu pada peralihan antara fase teratur jangka pendek dan jangka panjang dalam model Ising random-bond.
examples.suggested: ...peralihan antara fase dengan keteraturan jarak dekat dan jarak jauh dalam model Ising random-bond.
examples.why: "jangka pendek/panjang" is temporal in Indonesian (short-/long-term). The distinction here is spatial (range of correlations), so the learner is taught the wrong discriminator for the two phases — the defining concept of the whole tutorial.

examples.source: When the $R_{ZZ}$ angle is tuned down from $\frac{\pi}{2}$, the long-range order can still be recovered up until a critical angle... Below this angle, the resulting state no longer exhibits long-range entanglement.
examples.translation: Ketika sudut $R_{ZZ}$ diturunkan dari $\frac{\pi}{2}$, ketertiban jangka panjang masih bisa dipulihkan hingga sudut kritis tertentu... Di bawah sudut ini, keadaan yang dihasilkan tidak lagi menunjukkan jerat jangka panjang.
examples.suggested: ...keteraturan jarak jauh masih bisa dipulihkan hingga sudut kritis... tidak lagi menunjukkan keterjeratan jarak jauh.
examples.why: Here nothing in the surrounding text restores the spatial sense, so the reader is left believing the critical angle governs how long the order persists in time. "ketertiban" additionally means public order/discipline, not physical ordering.

examples.source: long-range entanglement / a greater degree of entanglement
examples.translation: jerat jangka panjang / tingkat jerat yang lebih besar
examples.suggested: keterjeratan jarak jauh / tingkat keterjeratan yang lebih tinggi
examples.why: Bare "jerat" is a snare/noose, not the quantum-information noun; Indonesian technical writing uses "keterjeratan" (or keeps "entanglement"). The file already uses the verb forms "menjerat"/"terjerat" correctly, so the noun is the odd one out.

examples.source: so the transition is at the edge of what this sweep can resolve.
examples.translation: sehingga transisi berada di tepi batas yang bisa diselesaikan oleh sapuan ini.
examples.suggested: ...sehingga transisi berada di tepi batas daya pisah (resolusi) sapuan ini.
examples.why: "diselesaikan" reads as "completed/solved"; "resolve" here means to distinguish/resolve a feature. The reader loses the point that the peak is at the limit of the sweep's resolving power.

examples.source: This value is maximized at the critical point of the Nishimori phase transition.
examples.translation: Nilai ini dimaksimalkan pada titik kritis dari transisi fase Nishimori.
examples.suggested: Nilai ini mencapai maksimum pada titik kritis transisi fase Nishimori.
examples.why: "dimaksimalkan" is agentive passive ("is being maximized by someone"), suggesting the experimenter tunes it; the English states an observed property of the curve.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every quantitative claim survives (six slices → six not eight groups, "melebihi delapan", the anti-commuting IZ example, the ≃0.89 tensor-network reference, the truncation/error-budget caveat), and the informal "kamu" register holds consistently. What a native technical editor would change is a handful of calques: "kedua nilai ekspektasi tersebut sepakat" uses *sepakat* (people reaching agreement) where values agreeing needs *cocok/bersesuaian*; "Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik" literally maps "found … interesting" onto *menemukan* (to discover); and "Sementara pemangkasan … memperkenalkan beberapa aproksimasi" stacks a concessive-"while"→*Sementara* calque on *beberapa* ("several") for uncountable "some approximation". There is also a within-file terminology split on noise: "noise" is correctly *derau* everywhere (simulator tanpa derau, pengurangan derau), but "noisy" becomes *berisik* ("hardware yang berisik", "simulasi berisik"), which in Indonesian means audibly loud rather than noise-affected. None of this misleads a learner; all of it is surface polish.

examples.source: As expected, the two expectation values agree.
examples.translation: Seperti yang diharapkan, kedua nilai ekspektasi tersebut sepakat.
examples.suggested: Seperti yang diharapkan, kedua nilai ekspektasi tersebut bersesuaian (atau: cocok).
examples.why: 'Sepakat' is agreement between people/parties; numerical values that match are 'bersesuaian/cocok/sama'. A direct calque of English 'agree' that a native technical writer would never use for two numbers.

examples.source: noisy hardware / noisy simulation
examples.translation: hardware yang berisik / simulasi berisik
examples.suggested: hardware berderau (hardware dengan derau) / simulasi berderau
examples.why: The file otherwise renders 'noise' correctly and consistently as 'derau' ('simulator tanpa derau', 'pengurangan derau'); 'berisik' means audibly loud, so the adjective breaks the established convention within the same file.

examples.source: While truncation allows more propagation by reducing the number of terms in the updated observable, it also introduces some approximation.
examples.translation: Sementara pemangkasan memungkinkan propagasi lebih banyak dengan mengurangi jumlah suku dalam observable yang diperbarui, pemangkasan juga memperkenalkan beberapa aproksimasi.
examples.suggested: Meskipun pemangkasan memungkinkan propagasi yang lebih dalam dengan mengurangi jumlah suku dalam observable yang diperbarui, pemangkasan juga menimbulkan aproksimasi.
examples.why: Concessive 'while' becomes 'Sementara' (temporal/meanwhile) and 'some approximation' becomes 'beberapa aproksimasi' ('several approximations', countable) — two calques in one sentence; 'memperkenalkan' for 'introduces' is also the wrong sense here.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.suggested: Jika kamu merasa materi ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.why: 'Menemukan X menarik' calques the English find+object+complement structure; Indonesian uses 'merasa … menarik'. Reads as fluent MT rather than authored prose.

examples.source: Your runtime might vary.
examples.translation: Waktu berjalan kamu bisa berbeda.
examples.suggested: Waktu eksekusi kamu bisa berbeda.
examples.why: 'Waktu berjalan' is a word-for-word rendering of 'run'+'time'; the established Indonesian technical term for compute runtime is 'waktu eksekusi' (or simply 'runtime').

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination; quantities ($m=9$, $n=3$, 100 simpul→sembilan qubit, `max_iter=50`), the sign/partition rule, the "keep the swap only if the cut improves" condition, and the ceiling-function and estimate caveats all survive intact, and the barren-plateau claim is not strengthened. The defects are consistency and polish. Three core nouns are split within the one file: "node" is rendered "simpul" through Latar Belakang/Langkah 1 but switches to the bare English "node" from Fungsi Loss onward ("partisi node $i$", "jumlah node dalam graph", "partisi node-node"); "graph" is "graf" early (line ~116, 122) but "graph" at line ~263; and "loss function" is "fungsi kerugian" at line ~49 but "fungsi loss" everywhere after (lines ~233, 251-253, 257). Separately, "sebagai tujuan demonstrasi" (line ~319) is a grammatical slip for "untuk tujuan demonstrasi", and "multi-body" is calqued as "multi-bodi" (lines ~23, 36, 45, 47) where a native writer would keep "multi-body" or write "multi-benda". The informal register ("kamu", "Wawasanmu", "aktualmu") holds consistently with no deferential slips.

examples.source: A loss function $\mathcal{L}$ of Pauli expectation values ... / For the loss function $\mathcal{L}$, we use a relaxation ...
examples.translation: Sebuah fungsi kerugian $\mathcal{L}$ dari nilai ekspektasi Pauli ... / Untuk fungsi loss $\mathcal{L}$, kita menggunakan relaksasi ...
examples.suggested: Pick one and use it throughout — "fungsi loss" (dominant here, 5 occurrences) or "fungsi kerugian".
examples.why: The same object is introduced under one name in Latar Belakang and then discussed under another for the rest of the tutorial; a learner re-reading the Background may not connect "fungsi kerugian" to the "fungsi loss" that is actually optimized. Recognizable either way, so MINOR.

examples.source: ...$x_i$ represents the partition of node $i$. ... $m$ is the number of nodes in the graph.
examples.translation: ...$x_i$ merepresentasikan partisi node $i$. ... $m$ adalah jumlah node dalam graph.
examples.suggested: ...$x_i$ merepresentasikan partisi simpul $i$. ... $m$ adalah jumlah simpul dalam graf.
examples.why: The file establishes "simpul" for node and "graf" for graph in the Background and Langkah 1, then abandons both for the bare English words from the Fungsi Loss section onward. Inconsistent, not misleading.

examples.source: In this tutorial, we set `max_iter=50` in the optimization loop for demonstration purposes.
examples.translation: Dalam tutorial ini, kita menetapkan `max_iter=50` dalam loop optimasi sebagai tujuan demonstrasi.
examples.suggested: ... dalam loop optimasi untuk tujuan demonstrasi.
examples.why: "sebagai tujuan demonstrasi" reads as "as a demonstration goal"; the idiomatic Indonesian for "for demonstration purposes" is "untuk tujuan demonstrasi". A small grammar slip a native technical writer would fix.

examples.source: multi-body Pauli strings / two-body Pauli-matrix correlations / $k$-body correlations
examples.translation: string Pauli multi-bodi / korelasi matriks Pauli dua-bodi / korelasi $k$-bodi
examples.suggested: Keep the English "multi-body"/"two-body"/"$k$-body", or use "multi-benda"/"dua-benda".
examples.why: "bodi" in Indonesian means a vehicle body/chassis, not a physical body in the many-body-physics sense; the calque is decodable from context but is not a term an Indonesian physicist would write. Consistent within the file, so MINOR only.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the γ/γ² sampling-overhead argument, the forward/backward/merged-bound story, the timeout-is-safe caveat ("Shade yang dihitung adalah upper bound di setiap tahap … ini tidak pernah meremehkan efek dari sebuah error") and all four closing result bullets (0,35 unmitigated, ~1,1 plain PEC, ~3,4 kali lipat reduction to γ²≈48) all match the English exactly. The file reads as if translated in two halves with different conventions: the Background/Step-1 half uses Indonesian ("sirkuit", "batas", "nilai ekspektasi", "pengukuran", "laju noise") while everything from "Memprediksi Pauli model-noise" onward switches to English ("circuit", "bound", "expectation value akhir", "measurement", "noise rate"), and the register flips from "kamu" (lines 18, 24, 78, 89) to "Anda" (lines 491, 680, 868, Next steps). Two term slips: "variance" is rendered "varian" (= variant) at lines 42 and 46 but correctly "varians" in the final bullet, and "operators supported on more qubits" becomes "Operator yang didukung pada lebih banyak qubit" (line 451), which reads as "backed/endorsed" rather than mathematical support. One nuance flattened: "it must almost commute with Z there" becomes "hampir pasti berkomutasi" (= almost certainly commutes), turning a statement about near-commutation into one about certainty; the operational takeaway survives, so it is a dropped qualifier rather than a false concept. Also a typo "passa self-consistency" (line 526) and one stiff calque at line 680.

examples.source: …then it must almost commute with $Z$ there.
examples.translation: …maka observable tersebut hampir pasti berkomutasi dengan $Z$ di sana.
examples.suggested: …maka observable tersebut hampir berkomutasi dengan $Z$ di sana.
examples.why: "almost commute" is a statement about the degree of commutation (near-commutation); "hampir pasti berkomutasi" recasts it as near-certainty that it commutes. The self-consistency argument of tighten_with_speed_limit is about how much the observable fails to commute, not about probability.

examples.source: This rescaling increases the variance by a factor of $\gamma^2$ … with reduced variance
examples.translation: meningkatkan varian dengan faktor $\gamma^2$ … dengan varian yang berkurang (but later: "varians statistik yang lebih kecil")
examples.suggested: meningkatkan varians dengan faktor $\gamma^2$ … dengan varians yang berkurang
examples.why: In Indonesian statistics the term is "varians"; "varian" means "variant". The file itself uses the correct "varians" in the closing bullet, so the term is split within one document.

examples.source: Operators supported on more qubits than this fall back to the looser triangle-inequality bound
examples.translation: Operator yang didukung pada lebih banyak qubit dari ini akan menggunakan bound pertidaksamaan segitiga yang lebih longgar
examples.suggested: Operator yang bekerja pada (memiliki support pada) lebih banyak qubit dari ini …
examples.why: "didukung" renders the everyday sense of "supported" (backed/endorsed), not the operator-support sense. Recognizable from context but a literal-but-wrong domain rendering.

examples.source: Your runtime might vary … You can interpret the behavior … the circuit you want to mitigate
examples.translation: Runtime kamu mungkin berbeda … Anda dapat menginterpretasikan perilaku … circuit yang ingin Anda mitigasi
examples.suggested: Use "kamu" (or "Anda") consistently throughout the file
examples.why: The second-person pronoun flips from "kamu" in the first ~40% to "Anda" from the bound-visualization sections onward, together with an Indonesian→English term switch (sirkuit→circuit, batas→bound, nilai ekspektasi→expectation value); it reads as two translators.

examples.source: A practical finding for learning-based mitigation with `samplomatic` is that it is highly beneficial for the deepest learning depth to match the depth of the circuit you want to mitigate.
examples.translation: Temuan praktis untuk mitigation berbasis learning dengan `samplomatic` adalah sangat menguntungkan bagi kedalaman learning terdalam untuk menyamai kedalaman circuit yang ingin Anda mitigasi.
