examples.suggested: Temuan praktis untuk mitigasi berbasis learning dengan `samplomatic`: sangat menguntungkan jika kedalaman learning terdalam sama dengan kedalaman circuit yang ingin kamu mitigasi.
examples.why: "adalah sangat menguntungkan bagi … untuk menyamai" is a direct calque of the English "it is beneficial for X to match Y" construction; no Indonesian technical writer would build the sentence this way.

examples.source: What this function adds is a self-consistency pass that leverages the limited speed…
examples.translation: Yang ditambahkan oleh fungsi ini adalah passa self-consistency yang memanfaatkan kecepatan terbatas…
examples.suggested: …adalah sebuah pass self-consistency yang memanfaatkan kecepatan terbatas…
examples.why: "passa" is a typo for the kept English term "pass" (used correctly elsewhere, e.g. "pass transpilasi `generate_boxing_pass_manager`" at line 351).

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no drift or hallucination: the parameter assignment ($0$ for the first two Rx layers, $\pi$ for the last), the ideal values "$-1$ dan $+1$" with their "masing-masing" ordering, the sampling overhead of 6 giving $6^{num\_reps}$, and the caveat "studi ini tidak menyertakan teknik penekanan atau mitigasi error apa pun" all survive intact. The defect is that the file is translated in two visibly different conventions: the Background/Step-1 half keeps "Circuit", "Gate", "Qubit", "observable", while everything from Step 2 onward switches to "sirkuit", "gate", "qubit", "observabel" — the same concept named two ways inside one page ("Circuit abstrak dan observable" at Step 1 vs "Sirkuit abstrak dan observabel" at Step 2). Register also mixes: "Waktu proses kamu" / "pastikan kamu telah menginstal" early, but "Pendapat Anda" in the survey paragraph. One calque remains: "sirkuit yang tidak dipotong akan menderita banyak gate SWAP" is a literal rendering of "will suffer from" that no Indonesian technical writer would use.

examples.source: Abstract circuit and observables / Target circuit and observables
examples.translation: "Circuit abstrak dan observable" (Step 1) vs "Sirkuit abstrak dan observabel" (Step 2)
examples.suggested: Pick one convention for the whole file — e.g. "sirkuit" + "observabel" throughout (or keep both in English throughout), not one half each.
examples.why: The identical English phrase is rendered two different ways in two adjacent step-header I/O boxes of the same page; a learner scanning them sees what looks like two different objects.

examples.source: TwoLocal circuit ... the transpiled circuit
examples.translation: "Circuit TwoLocal", "kedalaman Circuit" (early) vs "sirkuit yang telah ditranspilasi", "gate 2-qubit" (later)
examples.suggested: Unify on "sirkuit TwoLocal" / "kedalaman sirkuit", with lowercase "qubit" and "gate" throughout.
examples.why: Circuit/Gate/Qubit are capitalized English in roughly the first 40% and Indonesian lowercase in the remaining 60%, so the page reads as two translations stitched together.

examples.source: such an uncut circuit will suffer from a large number of SWAP gates required to implement the 2-qubit operation between the first and the last qubits
examples.translation: sirkuit yang tidak dipotong akan menderita banyak gate SWAP yang diperlukan untuk mengimplementasikan operasi 2-qubit antara qubit pertama dan terakhir
examples.suggested: sirkuit tanpa pemotongan akan terbebani oleh banyaknya gate SWAP yang diperlukan untuk ...
examples.why: "menderita" is a word-for-word calque of "suffer from"; in Indonesian it reads as a person suffering rather than a circuit paying a cost. The meaning still gets through, so this is stylistic only.

examples.source: Your runtime might vary / be sure you have the following installed / Your insights will help us
examples.translation: "Waktu proses kamu", "pastikan kamu telah menginstal" vs "Pendapat Anda akan membantu kami"
examples.suggested: Use "kamu" in the survey paragraph too, matching the file's own convention.
examples.why: Mixed kamu/Anda within one page: the informal convention is established in the opening lines and then dropped at the end.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat: the ZNE definition keeps both italicized poles ("efek noise *yang tidak diketahui* ... diskalakan dengan cara *yang diketahui*"), all three amplification methods keep their caveats ("Kalibrasi juga membutuhkan biaya yang besar", "faktor peregangan yang besar sehingga sangat membatasi kedalaman Circuit"), and every quantity in the PubResult axis list survives intact (124 virtual qubit, 12 nilai parameter, 2 ekstrapolator, 20 titik ekstrapolasi, 3 faktor). Informal register ("kamu", "eksperimenmu", "Observabelmu") holds consistently. What a native editor would still change: (1) "circuit" is rendered as the kept term "Circuit" everywhere except ZNE step 2, which says "sirkuit" — an unnecessary within-file split; (2) one sentence mixes "perangkat keras" and "hardware" for the same referent within a single clause pair; (3) two calqued constructions a native technical writer would rewrite — "Ada tiga cara umum amplifikasi error diimplementasikan untuk ZNE" (English passive word order transplanted whole) and "Observabelmu juga didefinisikan dalam konteks virtual qubit" for "in terms of the virtual qubits". None of these mislead.

examples.source: 2. Run every noise-amplified circuit to measure ...
examples.translation: 2. Jalankan setiap sirkuit yang noise-nya telah diperkuat untuk mengukur ...
examples.suggested: Jalankan setiap Circuit yang noise-nya telah diperkuat untuk mengukur ...
examples.why: "circuit" is kept as capitalized "Circuit" in every other occurrence in this file (lines 42, 54, 78, 80, 102, 635, 646, 648). This one step of the three-step ZNE recipe switches to "sirkuit", so the numbered list reads as if two different objects were meant. Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR.

examples.source: There are three common ways error amplification is implemented for ZNE.
examples.translation: Ada tiga cara umum amplifikasi error diimplementasikan untuk ZNE.
examples.suggested: Ada tiga cara umum untuk mengimplementasikan amplifikasi error pada ZNE.
examples.why: The English passive relative clause is transplanted word-for-word; Indonesian cannot stack "cara umum X diimplementasikan" without a relative marker, so the sentence reads as raw MT at exactly the point where the comparison table is introduced. Grammatical enough to parse, but a native technical writer would not write it.

examples.source: Your observable is also defined in terms of the virtual qubits, so you need to apply this layout to the observable.
examples.translation: Observabelmu juga didefinisikan dalam konteks virtual qubit, sehingga kamu perlu menerapkan layout ini ke observabel.
examples.suggested: Observabelmu juga dinyatakan dalam basis virtual qubit, sehingga kamu perlu menerapkan layout ini ke observabel.
examples.why: "in terms of" is calqued as "dalam konteks" (= "in the context of"), which blurs the technical point that the observable is expressed over the virtual-qubit indices, not merely discussed in that setting. The following sentence still makes the action clear, so it does not mislead — but "dinyatakan dalam basis" is the conventional rendering.

examples.source: Before running the circuit on hardware, optimize it for hardware execution.
examples.translation: Sebelum menjalankan Circuit di perangkat keras, optimalkan dulu untuk eksekusi di hardware.
examples.suggested: Sebelum menjalankan Circuit di perangkat keras, optimalkan dulu untuk eksekusi di perangkat keras.
examples.why: The same referent is rendered two ways inside one sentence ("perangkat keras" then "hardware"). The rest of the file uses "perangkat keras" consistently (lines 538, 637, 641, 646, 673), so this is a one-off slip rather than a deliberate convention.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: the load-bearing claims all survive intact — the Appendix keeps both conditions correctly ordered and directed ("pemisahan geometris ... harus kira-kira dalam orde √N", "kompleksitas model klasik dalam orde N sementara kompleksitas model yang diproyeksikan secara kuantum jauh lebih kecil dari N"), and the PQK-vs-standard-kernel contrast in Background (lower sampling overhead, better noise robustness, better scalability) is faithful. What a native editor would change is consistency: "classical" alternates between "klasikal" (Background: "data klasikal", "domain klasikal") and "klasik" (rest of the file: "dataset klasik", "SVM klasik", "Benchmarking klasik"), and "quantum" is sometimes left in English ("ruang fitur quantum", "state quantum", "komputer quantum", "masalah quantum") and sometimes rendered "kuantum" ("feature map kuantum", "state kuantum", "keunggulan kuantum") — often in adjacent sentences. "projective measurement" is spelled "pengukuran projektif" twice where standard Indonesian is "proyektif". Two smaller slips: the qualifier "safely" is dropped from "this step will safely overwrite them" → "langkah ini akan menimpanya", and the Next-steps opener "Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik" is a word-for-word calque of "If you found this work interesting". The informal "kamu" register holds throughout with no deferential slips.

examples.source: encode classical data into a quantum feature space … quantum states … quantum computers
examples.translation: mengenkode data klasikal ke dalam ruang fitur quantum … state quantum … komputer quantum (vs. later: feature map kuantum, state kuantum, perangkat keras kuantum, Circuit kuantum)
examples.suggested: Pick one convention and hold it — either "kuantum" throughout or English "quantum" throughout; e.g. "ruang fitur kuantum", "state kuantum", "komputer kuantum".
examples.why: The same concept is rendered two ways within the file, sometimes in consecutive sentences (§Latar belakang uses "quantum" in para 2 and "kuantum" in paras 3–4), which reads as two different translators. Concept stays identifiable, so MINOR.

examples.source: classical data / classical domain / classical benchmark
examples.translation: data klasikal, domain klasikal, metode klasikal (Background) vs. dataset klasik, SVM klasik, kompleksitas model klasik, Benchmarking klasik (rest of file)
examples.suggested: Use "klasik" everywhere; it is the standard Indonesian adjective and already dominates the file.
examples.why: "klasikal" is the less idiomatic variant and is confined to the Background section, leaving a visible split against the "klasik" used from §Circuit kuantum onward.

examples.source: obtained through projective measurements of the quantum feature map
examples.translation: yang diperoleh melalui pengukuran projektif dari feature map kuantum
examples.suggested: pengukuran proyektif
examples.why: "projektif" keeps the English <j> spelling; standard Indonesian orthography is "proyektif" (cf. "proyeksi", which the same file uses correctly in "hasil proyeksi" and "proyeksi kuantum"). Recognizable, so MINOR.

examples.source: If you already have these files locally, this step will safely overwrite them to ensure version consistency.
examples.translation: Jika kamu sudah memiliki file-file ini secara lokal, langkah ini akan menimpanya untuk memastikan konsistensi versi.
examples.suggested: … langkah ini akan menimpanya dengan aman untuk memastikan konsistensi versi.
examples.why: The reassurance "safely" is dropped, so the Indonesian reads as a bare warning that your local files will be overwritten. The instruction is still correct and the learner is not misled about what happens, hence MINOR rather than FAIL.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.translation: Jika kamu menemukan pekerjaan ini menarik, kamu mungkin tertarik dengan materi berikut:
examples.suggested: Kalau kamu merasa materi ini menarik, kamu mungkin juga tertarik dengan bahan berikut:
examples.why: "menemukan X menarik" is a word-for-word calque of English "find X interesting", and "pekerjaan" reads as a job/task rather than a piece of work; a native technical writer would use "merasa … menarik" with "materi"/"karya".

editor_note: The technical content is faithful throughout — the PNA mechanism (propagating inverse noise channels into the observable rather than inserting corrections into the circuit), the four-step summary, the Hamiltonian/Clifford-angle caveat, the `optimization_level=0` rationale, the non-monotonic accuracy caveats on `max_err_terms`/`max_obs_terms`, and the closing PNA/TREX/PS comparison all carry the English meaning and would not mislead a learner. What a native technical editor would change is consistency: the core term "expectation value" is left in English in the frontmatter, Learning outcomes, Prerequisites and Background but switches to "nilai ekspektasi" from Step 4 onward ("nilai ekspektasi yang telah dimitigasi errornya", "estimasi nilai ekspektasi yang noise-aware"), and the same split affects "observable"/"observabel", "lapisan"/"layer", "anotasi"/"annotation", and "box" rendered as "mengemas" in the Learning outcomes but "mem-box" in Step 2. Two sentences are also slightly loose: "circuit dan observable yang noisy" attaches *noisy* to the observable as well (English: "a noisy circuit and observable"), and "modify/adjust the observable accordingly" becomes "sesuai kebutuhan" ("as needed") rather than "correspondingly". Register is consistently "Anda"/"kita" — correct and never deferential.

examples.source: Using the Estimator primitive to calculate expectation values … / To calculate an error-mitigated expectation value
examples.translation: …untuk menghitung expectation value dari sebuah observable … / Untuk menghitung nilai ekspektasi yang telah dimitigasi errornya
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering for the whole file — keep "expectation value" everywhere (matching the title and frontmatter) or use "nilai ekspektasi" everywhere.
examples.why: The file's single most important quantity is named two different ways, splitting the first half from the second; a learner scanning for the term loses the thread. Same split affects observable/observabel, lapisan/layer, anotasi/annotation.

examples.source: When running PNA, you always need to provide a noisy circuit and observable.
examples.translation: Saat menjalankan PNA, Anda selalu perlu menyediakan circuit dan observable yang noisy.
examples.suggested: Saat menjalankan PNA, Anda selalu perlu menyediakan sebuah circuit yang noisy beserta observable-nya.
examples.why: The Indonesian post-modifier "yang noisy" scopes over both nouns, implying the observable itself must be noisy. In English only the circuit is noisy; the observable is the plain target operator.

examples.source: …modify the observable accordingly / …adjust the observable accordingly
examples.translation: …memodifikasi observable sesuai kebutuhan / …menyesuaikan observable sesuai kebutuhan
examples.suggested: …memodifikasi/menyesuaikan observable secara sesuai (or: sesuai dengan itu)
examples.why: "sesuai kebutuhan" reads as "as needed", i.e. optional and discretionary, whereas "accordingly" means the observable is changed to match the propagated noise — the whole point of the technique.

examples.source: These boxes allow us to associate each layer of the circuit with its own learned noise model.
examples.translation: Box ini memungkinkan kita mengasosiasikan setiap lapisan circuit dengan model noise yang dipelajari sendiri.
examples.suggested: …dengan model noise hasil pembelajarannya masing-masing.
examples.why: "yang dipelajari sendiri" reads as "learned by itself/on its own" rather than "its own learned model"; the per-layer possessive that carries the pedagogical point is lost, and a native writer would use "masing-masing".

examples.source: …to box and annotate circuit layers for twirling…
examples.translation: …untuk mengemas dan menganotasi lapisan circuit untuk twirling…
examples.suggested: Use the same verb as the body text ("mem-box") in the Learning outcomes, e.g. "untuk mem-box dan menganotasi lapisan circuit".
examples.why: "mengemas" (to pack/wrap) is introduced only in the Learning outcomes; the entire body then uses "mem-box"/"di-box" for the same samplomatic operation, so the reader meets the concept under a name it never carries again.

editor_note: No semantic drift found: every claim tracks the English, including the tricky ones (the closing admonition correctly keeps "5 menit" vs "15 menit" and the causal "Oleh karena itu, nilai mitigated akan menjadi lebih dekat ke nilai ideal"; the EN's own "four circuits with 5, 7, and 9" mismatch is faithfully carried over as "empat Circuit dengan 5, 7, dan 9 langkah Trotter", which is correct behaviour). The defects are consistency and polish. "noisy" is rendered three ways in the same file — "berderau" (bullet list, ~l.44), bare "noisy" (~l.683, 815) and "noise" inside "sadar-noise"/"noise residual" (~l.56, 60); likewise "error" alternates between "kesalahan" ("mitigasi kesalahan", ~l.44) and English "error" ("mitigasi error bebas bias", ~l.815), and "Qiskit Function" (~l.27) becomes "Fungsi Qiskit QESEM" (~l.815). Two phrasing slips: "perangkat lunak berbasis karakterisasi yang andal dan akurat tinggi" (~l.51) is ungrammatical — Indonesian wants "berakurasi tinggi", not the adjective "akurat" modified by "tinggi" — and "dari mana kita memotong lapisan-lapisan" (~l.208) is a direct calque of English "from which we cut out the layers" that a native technical writer would recast as "lalu kita potong lapisannya". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: comparing ideal, noisy, and mitigated results … on noisy quantum devices
examples.translation: membandingkan hasil ideal, berderau, dan yang telah dimitigasi … pada perangkat kuantum yang noisy
examples.suggested: Pick one rendering of "noisy" and keep it: either "berderau" everywhere or English "noisy" everywhere.
examples.why: The same core concept is rendered as "berderau" in the overview bullet and as bare English "noisy" in Steps 3 and 4 of the same tutorial; a learner cannot tell they are the same thing when the plot legend says "noisy".

examples.source: QESEM is a reliable, high-accuracy, characterization-based software
examples.translation: QESEM adalah perangkat lunak berbasis karakterisasi yang andal dan akurat tinggi
examples.suggested: QESEM adalah perangkat lunak berbasis karakterisasi yang andal dan berakurasi tinggi
examples.why: "akurat tinggi" is not grammatical Indonesian — "akurat" is an adjective and cannot take "tinggi" as a degree modifier; the noun form "berakurasi tinggi" is the conventional rendering of "high-accuracy".

examples.source: We use a hardware-based R_ZZ layer mapping taken from the Heron device, from which we cut out the layers according to the number of qubits we want to simulate.
examples.translation: Kita menggunakan pemetaan lapisan $R_{ZZ}$ berbasis perangkat keras yang diambil dari perangkat Heron, dari mana kita memotong lapisan-lapisan sesuai dengan jumlah qubit yang ingin kita simulasikan.
examples.suggested: …yang diambil dari perangkat Heron, lalu kita potong lapisannya sesuai jumlah qubit yang ingin disimulasikan.
examples.why: "dari mana kita memotong" is a word-for-word calque of the English relative clause "from which we cut out"; Indonesian technical prose chains with "lalu" or "yang kemudian" rather than a fronted relative pronoun.

examples.source: the benefit of using the QESEM Qiskit Function for bias-free error mitigation
examples.translation: manfaat menggunakan Fungsi Qiskit QESEM untuk mitigasi error bebas bias
examples.suggested: manfaat menggunakan Qiskit Function QESEM untuk mitigasi kesalahan bebas bias
examples.why: The product name is kept as "Qiskit Function" throughout the file (admonition, Background, Setup) but is translated to "Fungsi Qiskit" only in the closing paragraph, and "mitigasi kesalahan" switches to "mitigasi error" in the same sentence.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the Premium/Open Plan caveat, the `Session`→job-mode swap, the "linear coefficients vanish (b_i = 0)" reduction, the 100-node utility-scale framing and the COBYLA convergence discussion all survive intact, terminology is consistent (circuit/gate/qubit/backend/session/shot/noise kept in English; Hamiltonian biaya, keadaan dasar, pengoptimal, ansatz terparametrasi used the same way every time), and the informal "kamu" register holds with no deferential slips. What a native technical editor would still change: in the convergence paragraph, "cost improvements per step" is rendered "peningkatan biaya ... per langkah", which most readers parse as "cost *increase*" — the opposite direction from the minimization QAOA performs; the following clause "membedakan penurunan nyata dari jitter acak" rescues it, so it is ambiguous rather than misleading, but "perbaikan/penurunan biaya" is the right word. Beyond that, three calques and one non-standard form: the English "where"-relative is carried over literally as "jumlah sisi di mana titik-titik ujungnya"; "is what you would need" becomes "adalah apa yang kamu butuhkan"; "menunjukkan himpunan mana ia berada" drops the preposition ("berada di"/"termasuk"); and "terparametrasi" is a non-standard coinage where the field writes "terparameterisasi"/"berparameter" (recognizable, used consistently).

examples.source: but when the noise swamps the actual cost improvements per step, its linear-approximation model can no longer tell real descent from random jitter
examples.translation: tetapi ketika noise menenggelamkan peningkatan biaya yang sebenarnya per langkah, model aproksimasi liniernya tidak lagi dapat membedakan penurunan nyata dari jitter acak
examples.suggested: tetapi ketika noise menenggelamkan perbaikan biaya nyata per langkah (yakni penurunan biaya), model aproksimasi liniernya tidak lagi dapat membedakan penurunan nyata dari jitter acak
examples.why: "peningkatan biaya" reads as "cost increase", the opposite of the improvement (a decrease) QAOA is driving; only the next clause ("penurunan nyata") tells the reader the intended direction.

examples.source: The objective is to maximize the number of edges where the endpoints are in different sets
examples.translation: Tujuannya adalah memaksimalkan jumlah sisi di mana titik-titik ujungnya berada dalam himpunan yang berbeda
examples.suggested: Tujuannya adalah memaksimalkan jumlah sisi yang kedua ujungnya berada pada himpunan berbeda
examples.why: "di mana" as a relative pronoun is a direct calque of English "where"; Indonesian technical prose uses "yang".

examples.source: Each node is assigned a binary variable $x_i \in \{0, 1\}$ indicating which set it belongs to.
examples.translation: Setiap simpul diberi sebuah variabel biner $x_i \in \{0, 1\}$ yang menunjukkan himpunan mana ia berada.
examples.suggested: ... yang menunjukkan ia termasuk himpunan yang mana.
examples.why: "berada" needs a preposition ("berada di") or the verb "termasuk"; as written the clause is ungrammatical, a tell of literal transfer from English.

examples.source: The more general form above is what you would need to adapt this workflow to weighted graphs or other QUBO-expressible problems.
examples.translation: Bentuk yang lebih umum di atas adalah apa yang kamu butuhkan untuk mengadaptasi alur kerja ini ke graf berbobot atau masalah lain yang dapat dinyatakan sebagai QUBO.
examples.suggested: Bentuk yang lebih umum di atas itulah yang kamu perlukan bila ingin mengadaptasi alur kerja ini ke graf berbobot atau masalah lain yang dapat dinyatakan sebagai QUBO.
examples.why: "adalah apa yang" mirrors the English cleft literally and also flattens the conditional "would need"; "itulah yang ... bila" is the natural Indonesian construction.

examples.source: QAOA uses a parametrized ansatz circuit to prepare candidate ground states of $H_C$
examples.translation: QAOA menggunakan sebuah circuit ansatz terparametrasi untuk menyiapkan keadaan dasar kandidat dari $H_C$
examples.suggested: QAOA menggunakan circuit ansatz terparameterisasi untuk menyiapkan keadaan dasar kandidat dari $H_C$
examples.why: "terparametrasi" is a non-standard coinage; the conventional Indonesian form is "terparameterisasi" (or "berparameter"). Recognizable and used consistently, so cosmetic only.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every load-bearing caveat survives intact (the 80%/10%/10% qubit scoring weights, "hanya kurva dinamis yang ditingkatkan yang meminta MEM, ini tidak boleh diinterpretasikan sebagai perbandingan terisolasi DD versus tanpa-DD", "MEM ... tidak bisa secara retroaktif mengubah hasil pengukuran mid-circuit yang sudah digunakan oleh feedforward real-time", and the FC-DD labelling caveat), and no hallucinated claims. The defects are consistency and polish: "dynamic" is rendered two ways inside the same file — untranslated ("Konstruksi dynamic", "dynamic circuit", "Implementasi dynamic", "QFT dynamic") and Indonesianized ("QFT+M dinamis", "circuit dinamis", "kurva dinamis", "program dinamis") — with the same split on "classical-control" vs "kontrol klasik"; register slips from "Anda" (used in the usage estimate and Example-results sections) to "kamu" in the final Next-steps bullet. Smaller native-editor fixes: "menambahkan baik QFT unitary standar atau padanan semiklasik" calques English "either…or" (Indonesian wants "entah … atau"/"salah satu dari"), "meranking qubit" should be "memeringkat", and "perbandingan skala bergaya Gambar-2a" loses the sense of scaling behaviour ("perbandingan penskalaan"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: dynamic circuits / dynamic QFT+M
examples.translation: "Konstruksi dynamic", "dynamic circuit", "Implementasi dynamic" vs "QFT+M dinamis", "circuit dinamis", "kurva dinamis", "program dinamis terbesar"
examples.suggested: Pick one convention and hold it for the whole file — either keep "dynamic" everywhere (matching the code labels `dynamic/raw`, `dynamic/orbit`) or use "dinamis" everywhere.
examples.why: The same concept alternates between the English adjective and its Indonesian form within one page; the concept stays identifiable, so this is a consistency slip, not a misleading one. The same split affects "classical-control" (lines 20, 86) vs "kontrol klasik" (line 457).

examples.source: you must be careful of possible job failure modes … If you encounter negative stretch values
examples.translation: kamu harus berhati-hati terhadap kemungkinan mode kegagalan job … Jika kamu menemukan nilai stretch negatif
examples.suggested: Anda harus berhati-hati … Jika Anda menemukan nilai stretch negatif
examples.why: The rest of the page addresses the reader as "Anda" ("Runtime Anda mungkin bervariasi", line 18; "membandingkan hasil ini dengan hasil Anda", line 55). The final bullet switches to "kamu" three times — a register inconsistency a native editor would smooth out.

examples.source: The notebook then appends either the standard unitary QFT or its semiclassical dynamic QFT+M equivalent.
examples.translation: Notebook ini kemudian menambahkan baik QFT unitary standar atau padanan semiklasik dynamic QFT+M-nya.
examples.suggested: Notebook ini kemudian menambahkan salah satu dari QFT unitary standar atau padanan semiklasik QFT+M dinamisnya.
examples.why: "baik … atau" is a calque of English "either … or"; in Indonesian "baik" pairs with "maupun" and means "both", so the construction reads as machine-translated even though the intended meaning is recoverable from context.

examples.source: It is best read as a Figure-2a-style scaling comparison for this Orbit workflow
examples.translation: Sebaiknya ini dibaca sebagai perbandingan skala bergaya Gambar-2a untuk workflow Orbit ini
examples.suggested: Sebaiknya ini dibaca sebagai perbandingan penskalaan bergaya Gambar-2a untuk workflow Orbit ini
examples.why: "perbandingan skala" reads as "comparison of scale"; the English means how fidelity scales with qubit count. "penskalaan" carries the behavioural sense. The surrounding sentence already makes the intent clear, so this is a polish issue, not drift.

examples.source: the selector ranks the current backend qubits using a score
examples.translation: selector meranking qubit backend saat ini menggunakan skor
examples.suggested: selector memeringkat qubit backend saat ini menggunakan skor
examples.why: "meranking" is an ad-hoc anglicism; "memeringkat" is the standard Indonesian verb a technical writer would use. Meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, no hallucinated claims; the numbers (row 15/column 20, N(N+1)/2, O(N²), fidelity 0.8261 vs 0.7517, "darker red = fidelities closer to 1.0") and the whole Step 1–4 / hardware-example argument all survive intact, and the informal "kamu" register holds everywhere. What a native technical editor would change is surface: "circuit" is rendered two ways within the file — "sirkuit kuantum" in the Background and Step 1 prose ("pemetaan fitur dilakukan oleh sirkuit kuantum", "Kita membuat sirkuit kuantum...") but left as "circuit" from Step 1's I/O bullets onward ("Circuit abstrak", "circuit overlap", "circuit ditranspilasi") — and several sentences are visible English calques ("kita oleh karena itu menjalankan", "setiap entri memerlukan menjalankan circuit overlap", "Metode kernel kuantum adalah yang menggunakan...", "Juga berguna untuk memiliki pemahaman dasar tentang teori grup", "Jika kamu menemukan karya ini menarik"), plus inanimate "mereka" ("mengapa mereka penting", "mengembalikan perkalian dalam mereka"). The last-paragraph phrasing "untuk setiap entri uniknya sebanyak $N(N+1)/2$" puts the count after the noun where a reader could momentarily parse it as "N(N+1)/2 experiments per entry"; it still resolves correctly but should be reordered to "untuk masing-masing dari $N(N+1)/2$ entri uniknya".

examples.source: Output: Abstract circuit for calculating a kernel matrix entry. / We create the quantum circuit used to evaluate one entry...
examples.translation: Output: Circuit abstrak untuk menghitung entri matriks kernel. / Kita membuat sirkuit kuantum yang digunakan untuk mengevaluasi satu entri...
examples.suggested: Pick one and use it throughout — either "sirkuit" everywhere ("sirkuit abstrak", "sirkuit overlap", "sirkuit ditranspilasi") or keep "circuit" everywhere.
examples.why: Within-file split: the same concept is "sirkuit" in the Background/Step 1 prose and "circuit" in every I/O bullet and in Steps 2-4 and the hardware section. The concept stays identifiable, so this is MINOR, but it reads as two translators.

examples.source: To keep the demo short and to make a clean comparison, we therefore run the **same** seven-qubit instance...
examples.translation: Agar demo tetap singkat dan perbandingan bersih, kita oleh karena itu menjalankan instans tujuh-qubit yang **sama**...
examples.suggested: Agar demo tetap singkat dan perbandingannya bersih, kita karena itu menjalankan instans tujuh-qubit yang **sama**... (or: "...maka kita menjalankan instans tujuh-qubit yang sama...")
examples.why: "kita oleh karena itu menjalankan" copies English adverb placement; Indonesian puts "oleh karena itu" at the head of the clause or uses "maka". Grammatical but audibly translated.

examples.source: each entry requires running an overlap circuit whose two-qubit-gate depth grows with the size of the feature map
examples.translation: setiap entri memerlukan menjalankan circuit overlap yang kedalaman gate dua-qubitnya bertumbuh seiring ukuran peta fitur
examples.suggested: setiap entri mengharuskan kita menjalankan sirkuit overlap yang kedalaman gate dua-qubitnya bertambah seiring ukuran peta fitur
examples.why: "memerlukan menjalankan" (verb directly after memerlukan) is not idiomatic Indonesian — a native writer uses "mengharuskan kita menjalankan" or a nominalization ("memerlukan eksekusi"). "bertumbuh" is also off-register for a quantity; "bertambah"/"tumbuh" is standard.

examples.source: To fill out the entire kernel matrix, we would run a quantum experiment for each of its $N(N+1)/2$ unique entries.
examples.translation: Untuk mengisi seluruh matriks kernel, kita akan menjalankan eksperimen kuantum untuk setiap entri uniknya sebanyak $N(N+1)/2$.
examples.suggested: Untuk mengisi seluruh matriks kernel, kita perlu menjalankan satu eksperimen kuantum untuk masing-masing dari $N(N+1)/2$ entri uniknya.
examples.why: Trailing "sebanyak $N(N+1)/2$" sits next to the verb phrase, so on first read it can attach to the number of experiments per entry rather than to the number of entries. The meaning is recoverable, but the count belongs in front of "entri unik".

examples.source: kernel function ... returns their inner product / Quantum kernels and how they can provide ... / why they are important
examples.translation: mengembalikan perkalian dalam mereka / Kernel kuantum dan bagaimana mereka dapat menyediakan ... / mengapa mereka penting
examples.suggested: mengembalikan hasil kali dalam keduanya / Kernel kuantum dan bagaimana kernel tersebut dapat menyediakan ... / mengapa kernel kuantum penting
examples.why: "mereka" is used for inanimate referents (kernels, vectors) — a direct calque of English "they/their" that careful Indonesian technical prose avoids. Also, the conventional term for inner product is "hasil kali dalam" rather than "perkalian dalam"; the latter is recognizable, hence MINOR.

editor_note: No semantic drift and no hallucination: every prose claim matches the English, including the quantitative ones (presisi $\epsilon = O(1/2^m)$ dengan $m$ counting qubit, $\varphi=1/6$, 35 qubit, 40 detik) and the closing comparison paragraph (simulasi = baseline, hardware default mengaburkan hasil, Q-CTRL menajamkan distribusi). Register is consistently informal "kamu" throughout, and domain terms are correct and stable (eigenstate, eigenphase, counting qubit, inverse QFT, rotasi fase terkontrol, superposisi, dekoherensi, shot, Backend). Two small things a native technical editor would still change: "berkorespondensi dengan" is used twice for mathematical "corresponds to" — in Indonesian "berkorespondensi" carries the letter-writing sense, and "bersesuaian/sesuai dengan" is the conventional maths rendering; and the survey sentence "Luangkan sebentar waktu kamu" has inverted word order (natural: "Luangkan waktu sebentar"). Neither misleads the learner.

examples.source: the most likely measurement outcome directly corresponds to the binary expansion of the phase … the bitstring with the highest probability may no longer correspond to the correct binary expansion of $\varphi$
examples.translation: hasil pengukuran dengan probabilitas tertinggi langsung berkorespondensi dengan ekspansi biner dari fase tersebut … bitstring dengan probabilitas tertinggi mungkin tidak lagi berkorespondensi dengan ekspansi biner yang benar dari $\varphi$
examples.suggested: … langsung bersesuaian dengan ekspansi biner … mungkin tidak lagi sesuai dengan ekspansi biner yang benar …
examples.why: 'Berkorespondensi' in Indonesian usually means exchanging letters; for a mathematical correspondence a native technical writer uses 'bersesuaian dengan' / 'sesuai dengan'. Meaning is still recoverable, so this is a translationese slip, not drift.

examples.source: Please take a minute to provide feedback on this tutorial.
examples.translation: Luangkan sebentar waktu kamu untuk memberikan masukan tentang tutorial ini.
examples.suggested: Luangkan waktu sebentar untuk memberikan masukan tentang tutorial ini.
examples.why: Word order is inverted: the idiom is 'luangkan waktu sebentar'. 'Luangkan sebentar waktu kamu' reads as a calque of 'take a minute of your time' and is stiff in Indonesian.

editor_note: Delta entry 25 (the H3 "Plotting the dissociation curve for Li\_2S" → "Memplot kurva disosiasi untuk Li\_2S") is faithful and idiomatic: "kurva disosiasi" is the standard Indonesian chemistry rendering, the verbal prefix in "Memplot" matches the body text right below it ("Mari kita plot dan bandingkan hasil HiVQE dengan HF dan CASCI"), the escaped subscript Li\_2S and the anchor {#plotting-the-dissociation-curve-for-li-2s} are both preserved unchanged, and nothing is added or dropped relative to the English heading.

The four re-written step headings are all semantically faithful — nothing in them would mislead a learner ("Memetakan input klasik ke masalah kuantum", "Mengoptimalkan circuit untuk eksekusi pada hardware kuantum", "Menjalankan circuit menggunakan primitives Qiskit" carry the English meaning exactly, anchors intact). Two editorial slips remain. (1) The headings introduce renderings that clash with the body of the same file: "circuit" (lines 458/503) against "sirkuit" used throughout the prose (lines 68, 83, 140, 313) and capitalized "Circuit" elsewhere (lines 222, 231, 337); likewise "primitives Qiskit" (line 503) against "primitif Sampler"/"primitif Estimator" in the Background section (lines 23-26). (2) "Langkah 4: Pascaproses dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik" uses "Pascaproses" as a bare imperative verb, which is not idiomatic Indonesian — "pasca-" is a nominal prefix, and the same file already uses "pasca-pemrosesan" at line 339; a native technical writer would write "Lakukan pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil...". Neither affects meaning.

examples.source: Step 3: Execute circuits using Qiskit primitives
examples.translation: Langkah 3: Menjalankan circuit menggunakan primitives Qiskit
examples.suggested: Langkah 3: Menjalankan sirkuit menggunakan primitif Qiskit
examples.why: Both "circuit" and "primitives" are left in English here while the body of the same file consistently uses "sirkuit" (lines 68, 83, 140, 313) and "primitif Estimator/Sampler" (lines 23-26). Same concept, two spellings within one page; not misleading, but an editor would unify it.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return results in classical format
examples.translation: Langkah 4: Pascaproses dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik
examples.suggested: Langkah 4: Lakukan pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik
examples.why: "Pascaproses" as a bare imperative verb is not idiomatic — "pasca-" is a nominal prefix in Indonesian, and the file itself uses the noun form "pasca-pemrosesan" at line 339. Reads as a calque of the English verb "post-process".

examples.source: Step 2: Optimize circuits for quantum hardware execution
examples.translation: Langkah 2: Mengoptimalkan circuit untuk eksekusi pada hardware kuantum
examples.suggested: Langkah 2: Mengoptimalkan sirkuit untuk eksekusi pada hardware kuantum
examples.why: Meaning is exact and "eksekusi pada hardware kuantum" reads naturally; only the "circuit" vs "sirkuit" split noted above applies. Flagged for consistency, not accuracy.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats; the T1/T2 physics ("turun hingga sekitar 37% ($\frac{1}{e}$) dari amplitudo awalnya akibat proses dekoherensi dephasing"), the RB description and the closing caveat about longer chains giving "semakin sedikit kebebasan untuk memilih qubit fisik" all track the English exactly, and the informal "kamu" register holds end to end. Three editorial slips: (1) "Kita akan merangkas secara singkat" uses a non-word — the corpus convention everywhere else in id is "merangkum" (see compilation-methods-for-hamiltonian-simulation-circuits.mdx:532, sample-based-quantum-diagonalization.mdx:497); (2) in the caution admonition "the number lengths of RB experiments" is calqued word-for-word as "panjang jumlah eksperimen RB", which is meaningless in Indonesian — a native writer would say "jumlah dan panjang sekuens eksperimen RB"; (3) "it is good practice to collect fresh data" is rendered as "sangat baik untuk mengumpulkan data segar", which turns a recommended practice into an intensified value judgement and loses the "praktik yang baik" framing. None of these would make a learner form a false belief.

examples.source: We'll briefly summarize what these properties are and refer to experiments in the qiskit-experiments package
examples.translation: Kita akan merangkas secara singkat apa arti properti-properti ini dan merujuk ke eksperimen dalam paket qiskit-experiments
examples.suggested: Kita akan merangkum secara singkat apa arti properti-properti ini dan merujuk ke eksperimen dalam paket qiskit-experiments
examples.why: 'merangkas' is not an Indonesian word for 'to summarize'; the correct verb, and the one used consistently elsewhere in the id corpus, is 'merangkum'. Reads as a typo to any native reader.

examples.source: try adjusting the parameters of the experiment (like the times for $T_1$, $T_2$, or the number lengths of RB experiments)
examples.translation: coba sesuaikan parameter eksperimen (seperti waktu untuk $T_1$, $T_2$, atau panjang jumlah eksperimen RB)
examples.suggested: coba sesuaikan parameter eksperimen (seperti waktu untuk $T_1$, $T_2$, atau jumlah dan panjang sekuens eksperimen RB)
examples.why: 'panjang jumlah eksperimen RB' is a word-for-word calque of an already-garbled English phrase and parses as nothing in Indonesian; the intended parameters are the RB sequence lengths and sample count.

examples.source: However, it is good practice to collect fresh data on the device properties to understand its performance.
examples.translation: Namun, sangat baik untuk mengumpulkan data segar tentang properti perangkat demi memahami performanya.
examples.suggested: Namun, merupakan praktik yang baik untuk mengumpulkan data terbaru tentang properti perangkat demi memahami performanya.
examples.why: 'sangat baik' ('very good') strengthens a measured 'good practice' recommendation into an intensified endorsement and drops the practice framing; a small claim-strength shift, not a meaning error.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked the load-bearing claims paragraph by paragraph (two-qubit errors "secara sistematis *di atas*" the reported ones because of crosstalk, T2 "jauh *di bawah*", the 56/53/142 µs medians, "bukanlah bukti otomatis adanya drift") and found no inversion, swapped quantity, dropped caveat or hallucination; register is consistently informal "kamu", and domain terms (qubit, gate, circuit, backend, peluruhan, penundaan, superposisi, waktu relaksasi) are correct and consistent. What a native technical editor would still change is a handful of calques: "Ini diharapkan karena nilai yang dilaporkan diukur pada gate yang terisolasi" for "This is expected" (diharapkan = hoped for; wajar/memang diperkirakan is the right sense), "snapshot yang konsisten sendiri" for "self-consistent" (konsisten secara internal), and the code-switched "Sel berikut tidak akan return sampai..." and "backend yang di-pass". Two small fidelity slips: "downstream tools" flattened to "tool lain" (drops the downstream sense), and "noticeably lower T2 values" strengthened to "jauh lebih rendah". None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: This is expected because the reported values are measured on isolated gates, while the layer fidelity experiment runs many gates simultaneously
examples.translation: Ini diharapkan karena nilai yang dilaporkan diukur pada gate yang terisolasi, sementara eksperimen layer fidelity menjalankan banyak gate secara bersamaan
examples.suggested: Hal ini memang wajar karena nilai yang dilaporkan diukur pada gate yang terisolasi, ...
examples.why: "diharapkan" in Indonesian means "hoped for/desired", not "expected" in the predicted-outcome sense; a native technical writer would write "wajar" or "memang diperkirakan".

examples.source: The refreshed values are a self-consistent snapshot taken under conditions close to a real workload
examples.translation: Nilai yang disegarkan adalah snapshot yang konsisten sendiri yang diambil dalam kondisi yang mendekati beban kerja nyata
examples.suggested: Nilai yang disegarkan adalah snapshot yang konsisten secara internal, diambil dalam kondisi yang mendekati beban kerja nyata
examples.why: "konsisten sendiri" is a word-for-word calque of "self-consistent" that no Indonesian technical writer uses; the double "yang ... yang" also stacks awkwardly.

examples.source: The following cell does not return until all jobs and post-processing are done.
examples.translation: Sel berikut tidak akan return sampai semua job dan post-processing selesai.
examples.suggested: Sel berikut tidak akan selesai dieksekusi sampai semua job dan post-processing selesai.
examples.why: Bare English verb "return" inside Indonesian syntax reads as unfinished MT; same pattern as "backend yang di-pass" in the Step 3 admonition.

examples.source: ready to be compared against the reported values or passed on to downstream tools
examples.translation: siap dibandingkan dengan nilai yang dilaporkan atau diteruskan ke tool lain
examples.suggested: ... atau diteruskan ke tool di tahap berikutnya (hilir)
examples.why: "downstream" is flattened to "lain" (other), losing the pipeline-position sense that is the point of the phrase. Qualifier drop, not misleading.

examples.source: can yield noticeably lower $T_2$ values than the backend reports
examples.translation: dapat menghasilkan nilai $T_2$ yang jauh lebih rendah daripada yang dilaporkan backend
examples.suggested: dapat menghasilkan nilai $T_2$ yang terlihat lebih rendah daripada yang dilaporkan backend
examples.why: "noticeably" is strengthened to "jauh" (far). The numbers later in the section happen to support it, so it does not mislead, but it is not what the English claims at that point.

editor_note: The six delta entries are all headings and none of them misleads: meaning, scope and anchors match the English exactly (e.g. entry 23 "Contoh simulator skala kecil", entry 27 "Pilih backend", entry 45 "Langkah selanjutnya" are all idiomatic and correct). Three wording slips a native technical editor would still change. (1) Entry 29 renders "a sequence of bit-flip stabilizer circuits" as "rangkaian circuit stabilizer bit-flip" — "rangkaian" by itself is the standard Indonesian word for *circuit*, so "rangkaian circuit" reads as a tautology; "urutan sirkuit stabilizer bit-flip" (or "rangkaian sirkuit…") is what an Indonesian engineer would write. It also keeps English "circuit" while the surrounding body prose of this very section consistently uses "sirkuit" ("kamu akan membangun sirkuit yang (1)…", "selama sirkuit berjalan"), so the file now splits the same term two ways. (2) Entry 25 uses "hardware" ("Contoh hardware skala besar") while the sibling Step-2 heading uses "perangkat keras" ("Optimalkan masalah untuk eksekusi kuantum pada perangkat keras") — pick one. (3) Entry 41's imperative "Pascaproses" is a stiff, non-idiomatic verb coinage; "Pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil…" or "Olah hasil (pascapemrosesan) dan kembalikan…" is the natural form. Informal register ("kamu") holds throughout; no drift, dropped caveat, or hallucination anywhere in the delta set.

examples.source: Build a sequence of bit-flip stabilizer circuits implementing multiple rounds of error detection and correction
examples.translation: Bangun rangkaian circuit stabilizer bit-flip yang mengimplementasikan beberapa putaran deteksi dan koreksi error
examples.suggested: Bangun urutan sirkuit stabilizer bit-flip yang mengimplementasikan beberapa putaran deteksi dan koreksi error
examples.why: "rangkaian" already means circuit in Indonesian, so "rangkaian circuit" is tautological; it also leaves "circuit" in English while the body of the same section says "sirkuit" ("kamu akan membangun sirkuit yang (1)…"), splitting one term two ways within the file.

examples.source: Large-scale hardware example
examples.translation: Contoh hardware skala besar
examples.suggested: Contoh perangkat keras skala besar
examples.why: The Step-2 heading in the same file renders hardware as "perangkat keras" ("…eksekusi kuantum pada perangkat keras"); using the English word here makes the file inconsistent for a core term. Either convention is defensible, but not both.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return result in desired classical format
examples.translation: Langkah 4: Pascaproses dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik yang diinginkan
examples.suggested: Langkah 4: Pascapemrosesan dan kembalikan hasil dalam format klasik yang diinginkan
examples.why: "Pascaproses" used as an imperative verb is a coinage no Indonesian technical writer would use; the nominal "pascapemrosesan" (or a paraphrase such as "Olah hasil dan kembalikan…") reads naturally and keeps parallelism with the second imperative.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities or dropped caveats; the load-bearing statements survive intact ("Performa SQD hanya terjamin jika keadaan dasar bersifat jarang", "Energi yang dikembalikan oleh SQD dijamin merupakan batas atas terhadap energi ground state yang sebenarnya", "evolusi waktu oleh H2 setara dengan satu Gate CPhase", the seven XXPlusYYGate / three-electrons-into-4-empty-modes setup), and the informal "kamu" register holds. What a native technical editor would change: (a) "memproses pasca-pemrosesan kumpulan bitstring yang digabungkan dengan SQD" is both redundant ("process the post-processing") and syntactically ambiguous — it reads as bitstrings *combined with* SQD rather than post-processed *using* SQD; (b) one-/two-body terms are rendered as "suku satu-badan" / "suku dua-badan", a calque — Indonesian physics writing uses "satu-benda/dua-benda" (or "satu-partikel/dua-partikel"), "badan" being a body in the anatomical sense; (c) the same concept is split within the file — "keadaan dasar" (Background, Basis posisi) vs "energi ground state" (Hasil belajar, Langkah 3, Verifikasi energi), and likewise "state" vs "keadaan" / "sirkuit" vs "Circuit". None of these mislead; they are polish items.

examples.source: we will sample from this set of circuits and post-process the combined set of bitstrings with SQD
examples.translation: kita akan mengambil sampel dari kumpulan Circuit ini dan memproses pasca-pemrosesan kumpulan bitstring yang digabungkan dengan SQD
examples.suggested: kita akan mengambil sampel dari kumpulan sirkuit ini dan melakukan pasca-pemrosesan atas gabungan kumpulan bitstring tersebut dengan SQD
examples.why: 'memproses pasca-pemrosesan' is a tautology no Indonesian technical writer would produce, and attaching 'yang digabungkan dengan SQD' to 'bitstring' makes SQD read as what the bitstrings are combined with rather than the tool doing the post-processing.

examples.source: H_1 consists of one-body terms ... H_2 consists of two-body terms, which are quartic
examples.translation: H_1 terdiri dari suku satu-badan ... dan H_2 terdiri dari suku dua-badan, yang kuartik
examples.suggested: H_1 terdiri dari suku satu-benda ... H_2 terdiri dari suku dua-benda (atau: suku satu-partikel / dua-partikel)
examples.why: 'badan' is a body in the anatomical/organisational sense; the many-body-physics term in Indonesian is 'benda' (masalah banyak-benda) or 'partikel'. Recognizable but a literal calque, not the conventional domain term.

examples.source: ground state energy
examples.translation: 'energi ground state' (Hasil belajar, Langkah 3, Verifikasi energi) vs 'energi keadaan dasar' (Latar Belakang, Basis posisi dan momentum)
examples.suggested: pick one and hold it — 'energi keadaan dasar' throughout, or keep 'ground state' throughout
examples.why: The single most repeated concept in the tutorial is rendered two ways in the same file; a learner tracking 'keadaan dasar' in the Background has to re-map it at Step 3. Same split affects 'state'/'keadaan' and 'sirkuit'/'Circuit'.

examples.source: Due to the approximate translational symmetry in H_bath
examples.translation: Karena simetri translasi aproksimasi dalam H_bath
examples.suggested: Karena adanya simetri translasi yang bersifat hampiran (aproksimatif) pada H_bath
examples.why: English adjective order transplanted directly; 'simetri translasi aproksimasi' stacks two nouns and reads as 'approximation symmetry'. Also 'kejarangan keadaan dasar' later in the paragraph is a defensible but stiff coinage for 'sparsity'.

examples.source: Such circuits can be deep, which makes this approach better for applications to lattice models.
examples.translation: Circuit semacam itu bisa sangat dalam, yang membuat pendekatan ini lebih baik untuk aplikasi pada model kisi.
examples.suggested: Circuit semacam itu bisa dalam, yang membuat pendekatan ini lebih cocok untuk aplikasi pada model kisi.
examples.why: 'sangat' adds an intensifier the English does not carry ('can be deep', not 'can be very deep'). A small strengthening of the claim, not misleading, but unwarranted.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout the load-bearing passages — the symmetry/Hamming-weight explanation keeps right-half=spin-up / left-half=spin-down, the chemical-accuracy figures (`1 mH`, `1 kcal/mol` ≈ `1.6 mH`), the "fraction will be less than one but hopefully larger than uniformly random" comparison, and the `initial_occupancies` caveat about recovery failing without it are all intact; register is consistently informal ("kamu"). Five editorial slips: (1) in the generic-backend paragraph, "gate set yang secara alami diurai oleh ansatz LUCJ" inverts the agent — EN says the ansatz decomposes *into* that gate set, the ID says the gate set is decomposed *by* the ansatz; (2) "hadir setiap 4 orbital spasial ke-4" is a garbled merge of "setiap 4 orbital spasial" and "setiap orbital spasial ke-4" (the quantity 4 survives, but the phrase is ungrammatical); (3) "occupancy" is rendered two ways in the same file — "penghunian orbital" in the background/steps and untranslated "rata-rata occupancy" in the Visualize-the-results paragraph; (4) mathematical "support" is calqued as "didukung dalam sekumpulan state basis" / "dukungan signifikan", which reads as endorsement rather than mathematical support; (5) the section heading "Pemulihan konfigurasi yang konsisten sendiri" is a literal calque of self-consistent that does not match the body, which keeps "self-consistent" in English. None of these would make a learner form a false belief about SQD.

examples.source: we'll create a generic backend with a heavy-hex coupling map and a gate set that the LUCJ ansatz naturally decomposes to
examples.translation: kita akan membuat backend generik dengan coupling map heavy-hex dan gate set yang secara alami diurai oleh ansatz LUCJ
examples.suggested: ... dan gate set yang secara alami menjadi hasil dekomposisi ansatz LUCJ
examples.why: The passive with 'oleh' makes the ansatz the thing doing the decomposing to the gate set; the English says the opposite — the ansatz decomposes into that gate set. The relation is reversed, though the practical point (backend gates chosen to suit LUCJ) is still guessable.

examples.source: a connection between orbitals of different spin is present at every 4th spatial orbital
examples.translation: koneksi antara orbital dengan spin berbeda hadir setiap 4 orbital spasial ke-4
examples.suggested: koneksi antara orbital dengan spin berbeda hadir pada setiap orbital spasial ke-4
examples.why: Two competing renderings ('setiap 4 orbital spasial' and 'setiap orbital spasial ke-4') were merged into one ungrammatical phrase. The number 4 is preserved so the mapping rule is still readable, but no native technical writer would leave this.

examples.source: average occupancies of each orbital / the average occupancy of each spatial orbital
examples.translation: rata-rata penghunian setiap orbital ... vs ... rata-rata occupancy setiap orbital spasial
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout — either 'okupansi' / 'penghunian' or keep 'occupancy' in English, consistently.
examples.why: The same quantity, which is also the y-axis of the second plot, is named two different ways within the file; a reader may not immediately connect 'penghunian orbital' in the algorithm description with 'occupancy' in the results discussion.

examples.source: the wave function is supported in a set of basis states ... the ground state has significant support on the Hartree-Fock configuration
examples.translation: fungsi gelombang didukung dalam sekumpulan state basis ... ground state memiliki dukungan signifikan pada konfigurasi Hartree-Fock
examples.suggested: fungsi gelombang tertumpu pada sekumpulan state basis ... ground state memiliki bobot/tumpuan yang signifikan pada konfigurasi Hartree-Fock
examples.why: 'didukung' / 'dukungan' is the endorsement sense of 'support', not the mathematical support of a wave function; it is a consistent calque, so the concept is recoverable from context, but it reads as MT rather than as Indonesian physics prose.

editor_note: No misleading content: every load-bearing statement survives intact — the conditional in "Jika $r$ tidak genap, kita tidak bisa melanjutkan dan harus mencoba lagi dengan nilai $a$ yang berbeda; jika tidak, ada probabilitas tinggi..." maps the English if/otherwise correctly, "faktor sejati" is the right rendering of "proper factor", and the NMR result (15 → faktor prima 3 dan 5), the one-third qubit reduction, and the linear-vs-quadratic error accumulation are all accurate. What a native editor would change is consistency and a few calques: the central concept "order finding" is rendered "pencarian orde" throughout Steps 1–2 but switches to bare English "order finding" from Step 3 onward (lines ~555, 556, 558, 611), and "eksponensiasi modular" likewise becomes "modular exponentiation" in the Challenge section (line ~678). Register splits the same way — "kamu" in the intro and Requirements (lines 19, 47) versus "Anda" five times in Scaling/Challenge (lines 674, 678). Smaller slips: the English adjective "powerful" is left untranslated inside Indonesian prose ("komputer kuantum yang cukup powerful", line 37); "contoh instansi algoritma" (line 25) uses "instansi", which in Indonesian normally means a government agency, not a computing instance; "orthonormal" is flattened to "saling ortogonal" (line 82), dropping normality; and "klasikal" is used where the physics term is "klasik" (lines 556, 608, 611).

examples.source: the order finding problem / order finding circuit
examples.translation: "masalah order finding", "Circuit order finding" (lines 555-556, 611) after "masalah pencarian orde", "Circuit pencarian orde" (lines 74, 87, 92, 109)
examples.suggested: Keep "pencarian orde" everywhere (or the English everywhere), not both halves of the file differently.
examples.why: The same central concept is named two ways inside one tutorial; a learner following the argument from Step 1 into Step 3 has to re-anchor the term mid-read. Still identifiable, so MINOR.

examples.source: Your runtime might vary. / ensure that you have the following installed / test your understanding … Could you try to construct the circuit
examples.translation: "Waktu eksekusi kamu bisa berbeda", "pastikan kamu sudah menginstal" → later "menguji pemahaman Anda", "Bisakah Anda mencoba membangun Circuit", "Kami merujuk Anda"
examples.suggested: Pick one second person (the file's informal "kamu") and hold it through the Challenge and Scaling sections.
examples.why: Both forms are allowed by the convention, but switching from "kamu" to "Anda" in the last 25% of the page reads as two translators; no deferential bapak/ibu forms appear, so this is a consistency slip only.

examples.source: By efficiently solving this problem on a sufficiently powerful quantum computer
examples.translation: Dengan menyelesaikan masalah ini secara efisien pada komputer kuantum yang cukup powerful
examples.suggested: …pada komputer kuantum yang cukup kuat (or: yang cukup mumpuni)
examples.why: "powerful" is an ordinary English adjective, not a kept domain term, so leaving it raw inside Indonesian prose reads as unfinished MT rather than a deliberate loanword.

examples.source: How to run an example instance of this algorithm on hardware
examples.translation: Cara menjalankan contoh instansi algoritma ini di hardware
examples.suggested: Cara menjalankan satu contoh penerapan algoritma ini di hardware
examples.why: "instansi" in general Indonesian means a government agency/office; as a calque of "instance" it is a false friend that makes the learning outcome read oddly, though context still recovers the sense.

examples.source: all possible states of the top $m$ qubits are orthonormal to each other
examples.translation: semua keadaan yang mungkin dari $m$ qubit teratas saling ortogonal
examples.suggested: …saling ortonormal
examples.why: The normalization half of "orthonormal" is dropped. The conclusion drawn next (perfect distinguishability, rotation back to the computational basis) still follows from orthogonality alone, so this does not mislead — it is a dropped qualifier, not a changed claim.

examples.source: purely classical / return result in desired classical format / this part of the algorithm is classical
examples.translation: "murni klasikal", "format klasikal yang diinginkan", "bagian algoritma ini bersifat klasikal"
examples.suggested: klasik (komputasi klasik, format klasik)
examples.why: In Indonesian physics/computing writing the term is "klasik"; "klasikal" carries a classroom/group-instruction sense. It is used consistently here and remains recognizable, so MINOR.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantity, bound and caveat survives intact (10/30 situs, 3+2 vs 6+4 langkah terkompresi, "sisa lima dari 10 langkah Trotter berjalan sebagai Trotter biasa", GS fidelity 0.82 vs 0.98, the four-hour AQC vs 18-minute QPU contrast, and the estimator_options "menggantikan default fungsi sepenuhnya alih-alih menggabungkannya" warning), and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What an editor would change: (1) "dynamical structure factor" is rendered with the head noun inverted as "struktur faktor dinamis" ("structure of the dynamic factor") in the body (lines 22, 40, 59, 320), while the frontmatter description correctly says "faktor struktur dinamis" — one term, two orders, one of them backwards; (2) "baked into" is calqued as "dibakukan/bakukan" (lines 59, 320, 468), which in Indonesian reads "standardized", not "embedded into the circuit"; (3) smaller slips: "uji langsung dan terbantahkan" for "falsifiable test" (terbantahkan reads as "refuted"), the misspelling "koupling" for coupling (line 320), "langkah-langkah yang lebih terlambat dan lebih terentangle" for "later, more-entangled steps" (line 455), and half the H2 headings left untranslated (Prerequisites, Background, Requirements, Appendix) while Hasil pembelajaran / Langkah selanjutnya are translated.

examples.source: the dynamical structure factor $S(q, \omega)$
examples.translation: struktur faktor dinamis $S(q, \omega)$
examples.suggested: faktor struktur dinamis $S(q, \omega)$
examples.why: Head noun and modifier are inverted: "struktur faktor dinamis" says "structure of the dynamic factor". The file's own frontmatter uses the correct "faktor struktur dinamis", so the central term of the tutorial appears two ways. Recognizable thanks to the S(q, ω) symbol, hence MINOR, but it is the title concept.

examples.source: then bake in the neutron kick: a $\pi/2$ $Z$-rotation at the center site
examples.translation: lalu bakukan kick neutron: rotasi $Z$ sebesar $\pi/2$ di situs tengah
examples.suggested: lalu sisipkan kick neutron langsung ke dalam sirkuit: rotasi $Z$ sebesar $\pi/2$ di situs tengah
examples.why: "bakukan/dibakukan" is from baku = standard, so it reads "standardize the neutron kick", not "embed it into the same circuit". A calque of "bake in". The adjacent code comment rescues the meaning, so it does not mislead outright, but it is the wrong verb in all three occurrences.

examples.source: a compression plan that varies the ansatz depth (a deeper ansatz for the later, more-entangled steps)
examples.translation: rencana kompresi yang memvariasikan kedalaman ansatz (ansatz lebih dalam untuk langkah-langkah yang lebih terlambat dan lebih terentangle)
examples.suggested: ... (ansatz yang lebih dalam untuk langkah-langkah berikutnya yang lebih terbelit/entangled)
examples.why: "lebih terlambat" means "more delayed/late" (as in running behind schedule), not "later in the sequence"; "terentangle" is an ad-hoc Indonesian-English hybrid no native technical writer would produce. Elsewhere the same file uses the cleaner "entanglement rendah" (line 359).

examples.source: a direct, falsifiable test of a quantum simulation
examples.translation: uji langsung dan terbantahkan dari simulasi kuantum
examples.suggested: uji langsung yang dapat difalsifikasi terhadap simulasi kuantum
examples.why: "terbantahkan" is the resultative form and is normally read as "refuted" (cf. "tak terbantahkan" = irrefutable), so the phrase drifts toward "a test that has been refuted" rather than "a test that can be falsified". The Popperian nuance of the English flattens.

examples.source: ## Prerequisites / ## Background / ## Requirements / ## Setup / ## Appendix
examples.translation: ## Prerequisites / ## Background / ## Requirements / ## Setup / ## Appendix (left in English)
examples.suggested: ## Prasyarat / ## Latar belakang / ## Kebutuhan / ## Persiapan / ## Lampiran
examples.why: Section headings are inconsistently handled: "Hasil pembelajaran", "Contoh simulator skala kecil", "Muat templat fungsi" and "Langkah selanjutnya" are translated while five others stay English, so the page reads half-localized.

editor_note: No semantic drift: every load-bearing claim survives intact — the 2.7% interchain coupling, T = 6 K, the paper's extra factor of 2 in J, the zero per-site magnetisation that removes the explicit subtraction, the 0.65 / ~0.7 fidelities, the "Ini bukan regresi" caveat about the two-layer ansatz, and the closing two-spinon-continuum paragraph ("dibatasi dari bawah oleh dispersi spinon sinusoidal") are all faithful. What a native editor would change is terminology hygiene: "dynamical structure factor" is rendered two ways with the word order reversed — "struktur faktor dinamis" in the body (lines 22, 46, 70, which literally reads "structure of the dynamic factor") but the correct "faktor struktur dinamis" in the frontmatter description and in Step 4 (line 720). "circuit" is likewise split — "sirkuit" in the Learning outcomes and AQC sections (lines 24, 26, 80) but bare English "circuit" from the MPS section onward (lines 84, 437, 441, 543, 1150), and "ground state" alternates with "keadaan dasar". Smaller slips: the misspelling "koupling antar-rantai" (line 54, should be "kopling"/"coupling"), the hybrid "sangat terentangle" (line 58), a "kamu" at line 18 against "Anda" everywhere else, and the headings "Prerequisites" and "Background" left untranslated while all neighbouring headings are in Indonesian.

examples.source: dynamical structure factor (DSF)
examples.translation: struktur faktor dinamis (DSF)
examples.suggested: faktor struktur dinamis (DSF)
examples.why: The head noun is inverted: "struktur faktor dinamis" parses as "structure of the dynamic factor". The translation itself uses the correct "faktor struktur dinamis" in the frontmatter description and in Step 4 (line 720), so the same concept is named two different ways inside one file. Concept still identifiable via the DSF acronym, hence minor.

examples.source: circuit / ground state
examples.translation: sirkuit ... vs circuit ...; keadaan dasar ... vs ground state ...
examples.suggested: pick one convention per term (e.g. "sirkuit" and "keadaan dasar") and hold it through the whole page
examples.why: The first third of the page localises both terms ("sirkuit Trotter yang dalam", "menyiapkan keadaan dasar"); from the MPS section onward the file switches to bare English ("circuit persiapan ground-state", "circuit Trotter di atas akan terlalu dalam"). Defensible either way, but not both in one file.

examples.source: while the interchain coupling is only ~2.7% of J
examples.translation: sementara koupling antar-rantai hanya $\sim 2.7\%$ dari $J$
examples.suggested: sementara kopling antar-rantai hanya ~2,7% dari J
examples.why: "koupling" is not an Indonesian word — it is a half-transliteration of English "coupling". Either "kopling" or the plain English "coupling" would be correct; as written it reads as a typo to a technical reader.

examples.source: yet the ground state is strongly entangled
examples.translation: namun keadaan dasarnya sangat terentangle
examples.suggested: namun keadaan dasarnya sangat terbelit (atau: sangat ter-entangle / memiliki keterbelitan kuat)
examples.why: "terentangle" glues an Indonesian passive prefix onto an unadapted English stem; a native technical writer would either use the Indonesian term or keep the English noun, not hybridise the verb.

examples.source: Your runtime might vary. / be sure you have the following installed
examples.translation: Runtime kamu bisa berbeda. ... pastikan Anda telah menginstal hal berikut
examples.suggested: Use one address form throughout — "Anda" is used everywhere else in the page
examples.why: A single stray "kamu" in the usage-estimate line against "Anda" in every other second-person sentence (Requirements, Large-scale section, Next steps). Harmless but inconsistent.

examples.source: By controlling the bond dimension χ, we trade off accuracy against computational cost.
examples.translation: Dengan mengontrol bond dimension $\chi$, kita menyeimbangkan akurasi terhadap biaya komputasi.
examples.suggested: ... kita menukar (trade-off) akurasi dengan biaya komputasi.
examples.why: "menyeimbangkan" says "we balance", which softens the explicit trade-off the English teaches — the point is that more accuracy costs more compute, not that the two are brought into balance. Nuance flattened, but the learner is not misled about the mechanism.

editor_note: Entry 32 is semantically faithful: the CPLEX/Gurobi caveat, the "brute-force" random-sampling comparison and the lower-cost criterion all survive intact, and register stays on "Anda". Two editorial slips: (1) the rewritten entry mixes both Indonesian spellings of the core term inside a single paragraph — "perangkat lunak optimasi klasikal" / "perangkat lunak optimasi canggih" versus "masalah optimisasi" in the closing sentence — while the rest of the page (title, "masalah optimisasi biner tingkat tinggi", "fungsi objektif" sections) is largely on "optimisasi"; pick one form per file. (2) the hedge in "it suggests the quantum algorithm is effectively solving..." is rendered as the flat assertive "ini menunjukkan bahwa...", which reads a shade more certain than the English; "ini mengindikasikan" would keep the hedge. Neither would mislead a learner about the method or the result.

examples.source: classical optimization software … advanced optimization software … solving the optimization problem
examples.translation: perangkat lunak optimasi klasikal … perangkat lunak optimasi canggih … masalah optimisasi
examples.suggested: Use one form throughout, e.g. "perangkat lunak optimisasi klasikal … perangkat lunak optimisasi canggih … masalah optimisasi"
examples.why: Both spellings of the file's central term appear within the same rewritten paragraph, and the rest of the page (title, Background, Step 1) mostly uses "optimisasi"; the split is cosmetic but a native technical editor would normalize it.

examples.source: If the algorithm consistently finds lower costs, it suggests the quantum algorithm is effectively solving the optimization problem.
examples.translation: Jika algoritma secara konsisten menemukan biaya yang lebih rendah, ini menunjukkan bahwa algoritma kuantum secara efektif menyelesaikan masalah optimisasi.
examples.suggested: … ini mengindikasikan bahwa algoritma kuantum secara efektif menyelesaikan masalah optimisasi.
examples.why: "menunjukkan" states the conclusion as demonstrated, dropping the English hedge "suggests"; the claim is slightly strengthened, though the learner still draws the right inference from the histogram.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every quantity (1002/879/1040 targets, 2^20 = 1.048.576, 10x fewer entangling gates, ~10 vs ~100 iterations, 156 qubit, percentile 10/20/30 and approximation_degree 0.95/0.90, pass counts 1/2/3) and every conditional (is_feasible True/False branches, "tidak ada persyaratan untuk jumlah pasar yang sama, hanya target penjualan yang harus terpenuhi") matches the English, and the informal "kamu" register holds throughout. What a native editor would change is consistency: the file splits "constraint" between "kendala"/"berkendala"/"pelanggaran kendala" in the Background half and bare "constraint"/"pelanggaran constraint"/"masalah yang ada constraint" from Step 4 onward; "classical" alternates between "klasikal" (post-processing klasikal, input klasikal, masalah klasikal) and "klasik" (post-processing klasik, solver klasik, format klasik); and "fidelity" is "fidelitas ground state" in the bf-DCQO section but degrades to "kesetiaan ground state" in the Conclusion, where "kesetiaan" reads as human loyalty rather than the physics term. Two spots are translationese rather than written Indonesian: "algoritma powerful ini" (an untranslated adjective where "ampuh/canggih" belongs) and "Setiap suku dalam jumlah mewakili..." (a word-for-word calque of "each term in the sum"; a native writer would say "dalam penjumlahan tersebut"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: Enable rapid quantum evolution while maintaining ground state fidelity
examples.translation: Memungkinkan evolusi kuantum yang cepat sambil mempertahankan kesetiaan ground state
examples.suggested: ... sambil mempertahankan fidelitas ground state
examples.why: "kesetiaan" is the human-loyalty sense of fidelity; the same file already uses the correct technical term "fidelitas ground state" at line 485, so this is both wrong-register and inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: constraint / constrained problem / constraint violation
examples.translation: "masalah berkendala", "pelanggaran kendala" (Background) vs "Memvalidasi pemenuhan constraint", "pelanggaran constraint", "masalah yang ada constraint" (Step 4 + Conclusion)
examples.suggested: Pick one convention — "kendala" throughout ("pelanggaran kendala", "masalah berkendala", "formulasi kuadratik tanpa kendala")
examples.why: The core concept of the tutorial is rendered two different ways in the two halves of the same page; "masalah yang ada constraint" is additionally colloquial where "masalah berkendala" was already used earlier.

examples.source: Now let's see this powerful algorithm in action on our Market Split problem!
examples.translation: Sekarang mari kita lihat algoritma powerful ini beraksi pada masalah Market Split kita!
examples.suggested: Sekarang mari kita lihat algoritma yang ampuh ini beraksi pada masalah Market Split kita!
examples.why: "powerful" is a plain adjective with an ordinary Indonesian equivalent (ampuh/canggih) — leaving it in English here is translationese, not a kept domain term.

examples.source: Each term in the sum represents the squared deviation from the target sales for a particular product.
examples.translation: Setiap suku dalam jumlah mewakili deviasi kuadrat dari target penjualan untuk produk tertentu.
examples.suggested: Setiap suku dalam penjumlahan tersebut mewakili deviasi kuadrat dari target penjualan untuk produk tertentu.
examples.why: "dalam jumlah" is a word-for-word calque of "in the sum" and reads as a bare noun "amount"; a native technical writer would write "dalam penjumlahan tersebut".

examples.source: After the quantum optimization converges, Iskay performs classical local search post-processing:
examples.translation: Setelah optimasi kuantum konvergen, Iskay melakukan **local search** post-processing klasikal:
examples.suggested: Setelah optimasi kuantum konvergen, Iskay melakukan post-processing klasik berupa local search:
examples.why: English modifier order is carried over verbatim, so "local search" dangles before the head noun; Indonesian puts the head noun first. Also "klasikal" here vs "klasik" at lines 700/743/898 for the same word.

editor_note: No hallucinations and no inverted logic: every quantity (2^n, 3% rate → 40.000 shot → ~1.200 sampel, 20-qubit layout, dua job) and every caveat (unbiased-but-coarser estimate, learning noise costs QPU sampling, laju postselection turun saat check bertambah) survives intact, and "Anda" register holds throughout. Four things a native technical editor would still change. (1) "draw a random sample of its stabilizers" is rendered "gambar sampel acak dari stabilizer-nya" — "gambar" reads as *plot/illustrate*, not *take a sample*; the correct verb is "ambil". (2) "bare" is rendered "murni" four times ("payload murni", "state noisy murni", "circuit murni"), which collides with "murni" already used for *pure* ("state stabilizer murni"), so "state noisy murni" reads self-contradictorily as "pure noisy state"; "polos" or "tanpa check" is the right word. (3) "entangled with ancilla qubits" becomes "dijalin dengan qubit ancilla" — "dijalin" (woven) drops the quantum-entanglement sense that the whole check mechanism rests on. (4) "commits ... to the circuit" is rendered two ways in the same file ("menyimpan yang terbaik ke dalam circuit" vs. "check yang dikomit"), and the "search X for Y" calque appears twice ("mencari coupling map backend untuk jalur qubit", "cari coupling map-nya untuk layout qubit").

examples.source: Build the deeper circuit and draw a random sample of its stabilizers.
examples.translation: Bangun circuit yang lebih dalam dan gambar sampel acak dari stabilizer-nya.
examples.suggested: Bangun circuit yang lebih dalam dan ambil sampel acak dari stabilizer-nya.
examples.why: "gambar" is the wrong sense of "draw": in Indonesian it means to plot or illustrate, so the sentence instructs the reader to visualize a sample rather than to sample the stabilizer group — the action the code cell actually performs.

examples.source: Sample the bare payload and the checked circuits with Qiskit Aer. / Now compare the fidelity of the bare noisy state with the postselected state.
examples.translation: Sampel payload murni dan circuit yang telah dicheck dengan Qiskit Aer. / Sekarang bandingkan fidelitas state noisy murni dengan state yang telah di-postselect.
examples.suggested: Sampel payload polos (tanpa check) ... / bandingkan fidelitas state noisy tanpa check dengan ...
examples.why: "murni" is already used in this file for *pure* ("state stabilizer murni", line 57), so reusing it for *bare* produces "state noisy murni" — literally "pure noisy state", a contradiction in the very concept the section compares.

examples.source: a Clifford "payload" circuit is entangled with ancilla qubits to check certain invariants
examples.translation: circuit "payload" Clifford dijalin dengan qubit ancilla untuk memeriksa invarian tertentu
examples.suggested: circuit "payload" Clifford di-entangle (dibelitkan) dengan qubit ancilla ...
examples.why: "dijalin" means woven/interlaced in an everyday sense and loses the quantum-entanglement meaning, which is the physical mechanism that makes the ancilla syndrome informative.

examples.source: find_check_layout searches a backend coupling map for a low-error qubit path with many available ancillas
examples.translation: `find_check_layout` mencari coupling map backend untuk jalur qubit dengan error rendah yang memiliki banyak ancilla yang tersedia
examples.suggested: `find_check_layout` menelusuri coupling map backend untuk menemukan jalur qubit ber-error rendah ...
